```{r}
# =============================================================================
# AKDE DEEP-DIVE DIAGNOSTIC
#
# Focal animals:
#
#   CWD+:
#       A41
#       A43
#       A56
#
#   CWD-:
#       F91
#
# GOALS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#
# 1. Read the ORIGINAL ctmm UD objects.
#
# 2. Extract directly from each UD:
#       - AKDE low
#       - AKDE estimate
#       - AKDE high
#       - effective sample size for area
#       - bandwidth effective sample size
#       - bandwidth matrix characteristics
#
# 3. Determine whether one migration phase/window is responsible.
#
# 4. Compare focal UDs against the rest of the deer.
#
# 5. Examine underlying telemetry for:
#       - number of fixes
#       - tracking duration
#       - duplicate timestamps
#       - large temporal gaps
#       - large coordinate extent
#       - extreme sequential jumps
#
# 6. Inspect downstream AKDE CSV files.
#
# 7. Plot focal UDs directly from the .RDS objects.
#
# =============================================================================


# =============================================================================
# PACKAGES
# =============================================================================

required_packages <- c(
    "ctmm",
    "dplyr",
    "readr",
    "stringr",
    "purrr",
    "tibble",
    "tidyr",
    "ggplot2"
)


missing_packages <- required_packages[
    !vapply(
        required_packages,
        requireNamespace,
        quietly = TRUE,
        FUN.VALUE = logical(1)
    )
]


if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {

    stop(
        paste0(
            "Install the following packages firs<LOCAL_PATH>",
            paste(
                missing_packages,
                collapse = ", "
            )
        )
    )
}


library(ctmm)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)


# =============================================================================
# PATHS
# =============================================================================

MIG_BASE <- "<LOCAL_PATH>"

RES_BASE <- "<LOCAL_PATH>"


MIG_RDS_DIR <- file.path(
    MIG_BASE,
    "migratory_UD_lists_by_id_phase"
)


RES_RDS_DIR <- file.path(
    RES_BASE,
    "resident_UD_lists_by_id"
)


OUT_DIR <- file.path(
    RES_BASE,
    "AKDE_deep_dive_A41_A43_A56_F91"
)


dir.create(
    OUT_DIR,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
)


# =============================================================================
# FOCAL ANIMALS
# =============================================================================

TARGETS <- tibble::tribble(

    ~id,   ~cwd_status, ~movement_class,

    "A41", "CWD+",      "migratory",
    "A43", "CWD+",      "resident",
    "A56", "CWD+",      "migratory",
    "F91", "CWD-",      "migratory"
)


print(
    TARGETS
)


# =============================================================================
# GENERAL HELPERS
# =============================================================================

standardize_id <- function(x) {

    x <- trimws(
        toupper(
            as.character(x)
        )
    )

    x[
        x == ""
    ] <- NA_character_

    x
}


safe_numeric <- function(x) {

    suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(x)
    )
}


# =============================================================================
# FIND REAL .RDS FILES
#
# IMPORTANT:
# macOS creates ._ files.
#
# We DO NOT want:
#
#       ._A41_Phase_1_UD_list.rds
#
# We DO want:
#
#       A41_Phase_1_UD_list.rds
#
# =============================================================================

get_real_rds_files <- function(directory) {

    files <- list.files(
        directory,
        pattern = "\\.rds$",
        full.names = TRUE,
        recursive = FALSE,
        ignore.case = TRUE
    )


    files <- files[
        !startsWith(
            basename(files),
            "._"
        )
    ]


    sort(
        files
    )
}


# =============================================================================
# PARSE DEER ID FROM RDS FILE NAME
# =============================================================================

extract_file_id <- function(path) {

    filename <- basename(path)


    id <- str_extract(
        filename,
        "^[^_]+"
    )


    standardize_id(
        id
    )
}


# =============================================================================
# PARSE PHASE FROM FILE NAME
# =============================================================================

extract_phase <- function(path) {

    filename <- basename(path)


    phase <- str_match(
        filename,
        "Phase_([0-9]+)"
    )[
        ,
        2
    ]


    if (
        length(phase) == 0 ||
        is.na(phase)
    ) {

        return(
            NA_integer_
        )
    }


    as.integer(
        phase
    )
}


# =============================================================================
# INVENTORY ALL RDS FILES
# =============================================================================

migratory_inventory <- tibble(

    file = get_real_rds_files(
        MIG_RDS_DIR
    ),

    movement_class = "migratory"
) %>%

    mutate(

        id = map_chr(
            file,
            extract_file_id
        ),

        phase = map_int(
            file,
            ~ {
                value <- extract_phase(.x)

                if (is.na(value)) {
                    NA_integer_
                } else {
                    value
                }
            }
        )
    )


resident_inventory <- tibble(

    file = get_real_rds_files(
        RES_RDS_DIR
    ),

    movement_class = "resident"
) %>%

    mutate(

        id = map_chr(
            file,
            extract_file_id
        ),

        phase = NA_integer_
    )


rds_inventory <- bind_rows(

    migratory_inventory,
    resident_inventory
)


# =============================================================================
# SHOW FOCAL FILES
# =============================================================================

target_inventory <- rds_inventory %>%

    filter(
        id %in% TARGETS$id
    ) %>%

    left_join(
        TARGETS,
        by = c(
            "id",
            "movement_class"
        )
    )


cat(
    "\n\n",
    paste(
        rep(
            "=",
            100
        ),
        collapse = ""
    ),
    "\n"
)


cat(
    "FOCAL RDS FILES\n"
)


cat(
    paste(
        rep(
            "=",
            100
        ),
        collapse = ""
    ),
    "\n"
)


print(
    target_inventory,
    n = Inf
)


# =============================================================================
# RECURSIVELY FIND ctmm UD OBJECTS INSIDE AN RDS
#
# Some of your RDS files may contain:
#
#       one UD
#
# while others may contain:
#
#       list(
#           window1 = UD,
#           window2 = UD,
#           ...
#       )
#
# This searches recursively.
# =============================================================================

find_ud_objects <- function(
    object,
    object_path = "root"
) {

    output <- list()


    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Object itself is a UD
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        inherits(
            object,
            "UD"
        )
    ) {

        output[[object_path]] <- list(
            object
        )


        return(
            output
        )
    }


    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Search inside lists
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        is.list(object) &&
        !inherits(
            object,
            "data.frame"
        )
    ) {

        object_names <- names(
            object
        )


        for (
            i in seq_along(
                object
            )
        ) {

            if (
                !is.null(object_names) &&
                length(object_names) >= i &&
                !is.na(object_names[i]) &&
                object_names[i] != ""
            ) {

                child_name <- object_names[i]

            } else {

                child_name <- paste0(
                    "[[",
                    i,
                    "]]"
                )
            }


            child_path <- paste0(
                object_path,
                "/",
                child_name
            )


            child_result <- find_ud_objects(
                object[[i]],
                object_path = child_path
            )


            output <- c(
                output,
                child_result
            )
        }
    }


    output
}


# =============================================================================
# EXTRACT ONE AKDE SUMMARY
# =============================================================================

extract_ud_summary <- function(
    ud,
    file,
    id,
    phase,
    movement_class,
    object_path
) {

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # ctmm summary
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    s <- tryCatch(

        summary(
            ud,
            level = 0.95,
            level.UD = 0.95,
            units = TRUE
        ),

        error = function(e) {
            NULL
        }
    )


    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Defaults
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    area_low <- NA_real_
    area_est <- NA_real_
    area_high <- NA_real_

    area_label <- NA_character_

    dof_area <- NA_real_
    dof_bandwidth <- NA_real_


    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Extract CI
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        !is.null(s) &&
        !is.null(s$CI)
    ) {

        ci <- as.matrix(
            s$CI
        )


        if (
            nrow(ci) >= 1
        ) {

            # Find area row
            area_row <- grep(
                "^area",
                rownames(ci),
                ignore.case = TRUE
            )


            if (
                length(area_row) == 0
            ) {

                area_row <- 1

            } else {

                area_row <- area_row[1]
            }


            area_label <- rownames(ci)[
                area_row
            ]


            ci_names <- tolower(
                colnames(ci)
            )


            low_col <- which(
                ci_names == "low"
            )


            est_col <- which(
                ci_names == "est"
            )


            high_col <- which(
                ci_names == "high"
            )


            if (
                length(low_col) == 1
            ) {

                area_low <- safe_numeric(
                    ci[
                        area_row,
                        low_col
                    ]
                )
            }


            if (
                length(est_col) == 1
            ) {

                area_est <- safe_numeric(
                    ci[
                        area_row,
                        est_col
                    ]
                )
            }


            if (
                length(high_col) == 1
            ) {

                area_high <- safe_numeric(
                    ci[
                        area_row,
                        high_col
                    ]
                )
            }
        }
    }


    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Extract DOF
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        !is.null(s) &&
        !is.null(s$DOF)
    ) {

        dof <- s$DOF


        dof_names <- tolower(
            names(dof)
        )


        area_index <- which(
            dof_names == "area"
        )


        bandwidth_index <- which(
            dof_names == "bandwidth"
        )


        if (
            length(area_index) >= 1
        ) {

            dof_area <- safe_numeric(
                dof[
                    area_index[1]
                ]
            )
        }


        if (
            length(bandwidth_index) >= 1
        ) {

            dof_bandwidth <- safe_numeric(
                dof[
                    bandwidth_index[1]
                ]
            )
        }
    }


    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Bandwidth matrix
    #
    # Large bandwidth eigenvalues can indicate a very spatially broad
    # smoothing kernel / range structure.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    bandwidth_eigen_1 <- NA_real_
    bandwidth_eigen_2 <- NA_real_

    bandwidth_sd_1 <- NA_real_
    bandwidth_sd_2 <- NA_real_


    H <- tryCatch(

        ud$H,

        error = function(e) {
            NULL
        }
    )


    if (
        !is.null(H) &&
        is.matrix(H) &&
        nrow(H) == 2 &&
        ncol(H) == 2 &&
        all(
            is.finite(H)
        )
    ) {

        eigenvalues <- tryCatch(

            eigen(
                H,
                symmetric = TRUE,
                only.values = TRUE
            )$values,

            error = function(e) {
                c(
                    NA_real_,
                    NA_real_
                )
            }
        )


        eigenvalues <- sort(
            eigenvalues,
            decreasing = TRUE
        )


        bandwidth_eigen_1 <- eigenvalues[1]
        bandwidth_eigen_2 <- eigenvalues[2]


        bandwidth_sd_1 <- sqrt(
            max(
                eigenvalues[1],
                0
            )
        )


        bandwidth_sd_2 <- sqrt(
            max(
                eigenvalues[2],
                0
            )
        )
    }


    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Grid dimensions
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    grid_x_min <- NA_real_
    grid_x_max <- NA_real_

    grid_y_min <- NA_real_
    grid_y_max <- NA_real_

    grid_nx <- NA_integer_
    grid_ny <- NA_integer_


    r <- tryCatch(

        ud$r,

        error = function(e) {
            NULL
        }
    )


    if (
        !is.null(r)
    ) {

        if (
            !is.null(r$x)
        ) {

            grid_x_min <- min(
                r$x,
                na.rm = TRUE
            )

            grid_x_max <- max(
                r$x,
                na.rm = TRUE
            )

            grid_nx <- length(
                r$x
            )
        }


        if (
            !is.null(r$y)
        ) {

            grid_y_min <- min(
                r$y,
                na.rm = TRUE
            )

            grid_y_max <- max(
                r$y,
                na.rm = TRUE
            )

            grid_ny <- length(
                r$y
            )
        }
    }


    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Width of confidence interval
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    relative_ci_width <- if (
        is.finite(area_low) &&
        is.finite(area_high) &&
        is.finite(area_est) &&
        area_est != 0
    ) {

        (
            area_high -
            area_low
        ) /
        area_est

    } else {

        NA_real_
    }


    tibble(

        id = id,

        movement_class = movement_class,

        phase = phase,

        file = file,

        object_path = object_path,

        area_label = area_label,

        akde_low = area_low,

        akde_est = area_est,

        akde_high = area_high,

        relative_CI_width = relative_ci_width,

        DOF_area = dof_area,

        DOF_bandwidth = dof_bandwidth,

        bandwidth_eigen_1 = bandwidth_eigen_1,

        bandwidth_eigen_2 = bandwidth_eigen_2,

        bandwidth_SD_1 = bandwidth_sd_1,

        bandwidth_SD_2 = bandwidth_sd_2,

        grid_x_min = grid_x_min,

        grid_x_max = grid_x_max,

        grid_y_min = grid_y_min,

        grid_y_max = grid_y_max,

        grid_nx = grid_nx,

        grid_ny = grid_ny
    )
}


# =============================================================================
# PROCESS ONE RDS FILE
# =============================================================================

process_rds_file <- function(
    file,
    id,
    phase,
    movement_class
) {

    cat(
        "\nReading:",
        basename(file),
        "\n"
    )


    object <- tryCatch(

        readRDS(
            file
        ),

        error = function(e) {

            message(
                "Could not read: ",
                file,
                "\n",
                conditionMessage(e)
            )

            NULL
        }
    )


    if (
        is.null(object)
    ) {

        return(
            tibble()
        )
    }


    uds <- find_ud_objects(
        object
    )


    if (
        length(uds) == 0
    ) {

        message(
            "No UD object found inside: ",
            basename(file)
        )


        return(
            tibble()
        )
    }


    bind_rows(

        lapply(
            names(uds),

            function(object_path) {

                extract_ud_summary(

                    ud = uds[[object_path]],

                    file = file,

                    id = id,

                    phase = phase,

                    movement_class = movement_class,

                    object_path = object_path
                )
            }
        )
    )
}


# =============================================================================
# PROCESS ALL UD FILES
#
# We process everyone because we want to know whether A41/A43/A56/F91 are
# actually extreme compared with the other deer.
# =============================================================================

all_ud_results <- vector(
    "list",
    nrow(
        rds_inventory
    )
)


for (
    i in seq_len(
        nrow(
            rds_inventory
        )
    )
) {

    current <- rds_inventory[
        i,
    ]


    all_ud_results[[i]] <- process_rds_file(

        file = current$file,

        id = current$id,

        phase = current$phase,

        movement_class = current$movement_class
    )
}


all_ud_summary <- bind_rows(
    all_ud_results
)


# =============================================================================
# ADD TARGET STATUS
# =============================================================================

all_ud_summary <- all_ud_summary %>%

    left_join(
        TARGETS,
        by = c(
            "id",
            "movement_class"
        )
    ) %>%

    mutate(

        focal_animal = id %in% TARGETS$id
    )


# =============================================================================
# CALCULATE OUTLIER RANKS
#
# Migratory UDs are compared with migratory UDs.
# Resident UDs are compared with resident UDs.
# =============================================================================

all_ud_summary <- all_ud_summary %>%

    group_by(
        movement_class
    ) %>%

    mutate(

        AKDE_rank_largest = min_rank(
            desc(
                akde_est
            )
        ),

        AKDE_percentile = 100 *
            percent_rank(
                akde_est
            ),

        DOF_area_percentile = 100 *
            percent_rank(
                DOF_area
            ),

        CI_width_percentile = 100 *
            percent_rank(
                relative_CI_width
            )
    ) %>%

    ungroup()


# =============================================================================
# SAVE COMPLETE UD SUMMARY
# =============================================================================

write_csv(

    all_ud_summary,

    file.path(
        OUT_DIR,
        "ALL_UD_AKDE_diagnostics.csv"
    )
)


# =============================================================================
# FOCAL UD SUMMARY
# =============================================================================

focal_ud_summary <- all_ud_summary %>%

    filter(
        focal_animal
    ) %>%

    arrange(
        id,
        phase,
        desc(
            akde_est
        )
    )


cat(
    "\n\n",
    paste(
        rep(
            "=",
            120
        ),
        collapse = ""
    ),
    "\n"
)


cat(
    "FOCAL AKDE RESULTS DIRECTLY FROM .RDS FILES\n"
)


cat(
    paste(
        rep(
            "=",
            120
        ),
        collapse = ""
    ),
    "\n"
)


print(

    focal_ud_summary %>%

        select(

            id,
            cwd_status,
            movement_class,
            phase,

            akde_low,
            akde_est,
            akde_high,

            DOF_area,
            DOF_bandwidth,

            relative_CI_width,

            AKDE_rank_largest,
            AKDE_percentile,

            object_path
        ),

    n = Inf,
    width = Inf
)


write_csv(

    focal_ud_summary,

    file.path(
        OUT_DIR,
        "FOCAL_UD_AKDE_diagnostics.csv"
    )
)


# =============================================================================
# FLAG POSSIBLE PROBLEMS
# =============================================================================

diagnostic_flags <- focal_ud_summary %>%

    mutate(

        flag_extreme_AKDE =
            AKDE_percentile >= 95,

        flag_low_DOF =
            DOF_area < 10,

        flag_very_low_DOF =
            DOF_area < 5,

        flag_wide_CI =
            relative_CI_width > 1,

        flag_extremely_wide_CI =
            relative_CI_width > 2
    ) %>%

    select(

        id,
        cwd_status,
        movement_class,
        phase,

        akde_low,
        akde_est,
        akde_high,

        DOF_area,
        DOF_bandwidth,

        relative_CI_width,

        AKDE_percentile,

        starts_with(
            "flag_"
        )
    )


cat(
    "\n\n",
    paste(
        rep(
            "=",
            120
        ),
        collapse = ""
    ),
    "\n"
)


cat(
    "AUTOMATIC DIAGNOSTIC FLAGS\n"
)


cat(
    paste(
        rep(
            "=",
            120
        ),
        collapse = ""
    ),
    "\n"
)


print(
    diagnostic_flags,
    n = Inf,
    width = Inf
)


write_csv(

    diagnostic_flags,

    file.path(
        OUT_DIR,
        "FOCAL_AKDE_flags.csv"
    )
)


# =============================================================================
# INDIVIDUAL PHASE COMPARISON
#
# Especially important for:
#
#       A41
#       A56
#       F91
#
# We want to see whether ONE phase is creating the problem.
# =============================================================================

phase_summary <- focal_ud_summary %>%

    filter(
        movement_class == "migratory"
    ) %>%

    group_by(
        id,
        cwd_status,
        phase
    ) %>%

    summarise(

        n_UD_objects = n(),

        akde_low_min = min(
            akde_low,
            na.rm = TRUE
        ),

        akde_low_median = median(
            akde_low,
            na.rm = TRUE
        ),

        akde_est_median = median(
            akde_est,
            na.rm = TRUE
        ),

        akde_est_max = max(
            akde_est,
            na.rm = TRUE
        ),

        akde_high_max = max(
            akde_high,
            na.rm = TRUE
        ),

        DOF_area_median = median(
            DOF_area,
            na.rm = TRUE
        ),

        .groups = "drop"
    )


cat(
    "\n\n",
    paste(
        rep(
            "=",
            100
        ),
        collapse = ""
    ),
    "\n"
)


cat(
    "MIGRATORY PHASE SUMMARY\n"
)


cat(
    paste(
        rep(
            "=",
            100
        ),
        collapse = ""
    ),
    "\n"
)


print(
    phase_summary,
    n = Inf,
    width = Inf
)


write_csv(

    phase_summary,

    file.path(
        OUT_DIR,
        "FOCAL_migratory_phase_summary.csv"
    )
)


# =============================================================================
# PLOT AKDE ESTIMATES + CONFIDENCE INTERVALS
# =============================================================================

p_target_akde <- focal_ud_summary %>%

    mutate(

        phase_label = if_else(

            is.na(
                phase
            ),

            paste0(
                id,
                "\nResident"
            ),

            paste0(
                id,
                "\nPhase ",
                phase
            )
        )
    ) %>%

    ggplot(
        aes(
            x = phase_label,
            y = akde_est,
            ymin = akde_low,
            ymax = akde_high,
            shape = cwd_status
        )
    ) +

    geom_pointrange(
        size = 0.7
    ) +

    scale_y_log10() +

    facet_wrap(
        ~ movement_class,
        scales = "free_x"
    ) +

    labs(

        title =
            "AKDE Estimates for Focal Deer",

        subtitle =
            "Point = AKDE estimate; interval = 95% confidence interval",

        x =
            "Deer / Movement Phase",

        y =
            "95% AKDE Area (log scale)",

        shape =
            "CWD Status"
    ) +

    theme_bw(
        base_size = 14
    ) +

    theme(

        axis.text.x = element_text(
            angle = 45,
            hjust = 1
        )
    )


ggsave(

    filename = file.path(
        OUT_DIR,
        "FOCAL_AKDE_intervals.png"
    ),

    plot = p_target_akde,

    width = 11,
    height = 7,
    dpi = 300
)


# =============================================================================
# PLOT ALL ANIMALS WITH FOCAL ANIMALS IDENTIFIED
# =============================================================================

p_population <- all_ud_summary %>%

    filter(
        is.finite(
            akde_est
        )
    ) %>%

    ggplot(
        aes(
            x = movement_class,
            y = akde_est
        )
    ) +

    geom_jitter(
        width = 0.15,
        alpha = 0.35,
        size = 2
    ) +

    geom_point(

        data = ~ filter(
            .x,
            focal_animal
        ),

        aes(
            shape = id
        ),

        size = 4
    ) +

# =============================================================================
# FIND ID COLUMN FLEXIBLY
# =============================================================================

find_column <- function(
    data,
    candidates
) {

    names_lower <- tolower(
        names(
            data
        )
    )


    candidates_lower <- tolower(
        candidates
    )


    match_index <- match(
        candidates_lower,
        names_lower
    )


    match_index <- match_index[
        !is.na(
            match_index
        )
    ]


    if (
        length(match_index) == 0
    ) {

        return(
            NA_character_
        )
    }


    names(
        data
    )[
        match_index[1]
    ]
}

# =============================================================================
# TELEMETRY DIAGNOSTIC
#
# Potential explanations for a giant AKDE:
#
#   1. very long tracking duration
#   2. a phase accidentally contains migration
#   3. one or more extreme GPS locations
#   4. a long temporal gap
#   5. incorrect phase segmentation
#   6. sparse effective sample size
#
# =============================================================================


# =============================================================================
# HAVERSINE DISTANCE
#
# Returns distance in kilometers.
# =============================================================================

haversine_km <- function(
    lon1,
    lat1,
    lon2,
    lat2
) {

    R <- 6371.0088


    to_rad <- pi / 180


    lon1 <- lon1 * to_rad
    lat1 <- lat1 * to_rad

    lon2 <- lon2 * to_rad
    lat2 <- lat2 * to_rad


    dlon <- lon2 - lon1
    dlat <- lat2 - lat1


    a <-

        sin(
            dlat / 2
        )^2 +

        cos(
            lat1
        ) *

        cos(
            lat2
        ) *

        sin(
            dlon / 2
        )^2


    c <- 2 *
        atan2(
            sqrt(a),
            sqrt(
                1 - a
            )
        )


    R * c
}


# =============================================================================
# FLEXIBLE DATE PARSER
# =============================================================================

parse_datetime_flexible <- function(x) {

    if (
        inherits(
            x,
            "POSIXct"
        )
    ) {

        return(
            x
        )
    }


    suppressWarnings(

        as.POSIXct(

            x,

            tz = "UTC",

            tryFormats = c(

                "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
                "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M",
                "%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S",
                "%m/%d/%Y %H:%M",
                "%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S",
                "%Y-%m-%d"
            )
        )
    )
}

# =============================================================================
# SUMMARIZE TELEMETRY FILE
# =============================================================================

summarize_telemetry_file <- function(
    file
) {

    if (
        !file.exists(
            file
        )
    ) {

        return(
            tibble()
        )
    }


    cat(
        "\nTelemetry diagnostic:",
        basename(file),
        "\n"
    )


    data <- read_csv(
        file,
        show_col_types = FALSE
    )


    id_col <- find_column(

        data,

        c(
            "id",
            "deer_id",
            "identity",
            "animal_id"
        )
    )


    if (
        is.na(
            id_col
        )
    ) {

        return(
            tibble()
        )
    }


    phase_col <- find_column(

        data,

        c(
            "phase",
            "migration_phase",
            "movement_phase"
        )
    )


    time_col <- find_column(

        data,

        c(
            "timestamp",
            "datetime",
            "date_time",
            "date",
            "Date"
        )
    )


    lon_col <- find_column(

        data,

        c(
            "longitude",
            "lon",
            "long"
        )
    )


    lat_col <- find_column(

        data,

        c(
            "latitude",
            "lat"
        )
    )


    x_col <- find_column(

        data,

        c(
            "x",
            "utm_x",
            "easting"
        )
    )


    y_col <- find_column(

        data,

        c(
            "y",
            "utm_y",
            "northing"
        )
    )


    data <- data %>%

        mutate(

            diagnostic_id =
                standardize_id(
                    .data[[id_col]])
        ) %>%

        filter(
            diagnostic_id %in% TARGETS$id
        )


    if (
        nrow(
            data
        ) == 0
    ) {

        return(
            tibble()
        )
    }


    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Time
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        !is.na(
            time_col
        )
    ) {

        data$diagnostic_time <-
            parse_datetime_flexible(
                data[[time_col]]
            )

    } else {

        data$diagnostic_time <-
            as.POSIXct(
                NA
            )
    }


    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Phase
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        !is.na(
            phase_col
        )
    ) {

        data$diagnostic_phase <-
            as.character(
                data[[phase_col]]
            )

    } else {

        data$diagnostic_phase <-
            "Resident/No phase"
    }


    groups <- split(

        data,

        interaction(

            data$diagnostic_id,

            data$diagnostic_phase,

            drop = TRUE
        )
    )


    results <- lapply(

        groups,

        function(group) {

            group <- group %>%

                arrange(
                    diagnostic_time
                )


            id <- unique(
                group$diagnostic_id
            )[1]


            phase <- unique(
                group$diagnostic_phase
            )[1]


            # -------------------------------------------------------------
            # Time diagnostics
            # -------------------------------------------------------------

            valid_times <- group$diagnostic_time[
                !is.na(
                    group$diagnostic_time
                )
            ]


            start_time <- if (
                length(valid_times) > 0
            ) {

                min(
                    valid_times
                )

            } else {

                as.POSIXct(
                    NA
                )
            }


            end_time <- if (
                length(valid_times) > 0
            ) {

                max(
                    valid_times
                )

            } else {

                as.POSIXct(
                    NA
                )
            }


            duration_days <- if (
                length(valid_times) > 1
            ) {

                as.numeric(
                    difftime(
                        end_time,
                        start_time,
                        units = "days"
                    )
                )

            } else {

                NA_real_
            }


            gaps_hours <- if (
                length(valid_times) > 1
            ) {

                as.numeric(
                    diff(
                        sort(
                            valid_times
                        )
                    ),
                    units = "hours"
                )

            } else {

                numeric(
                    0
                )
            }


            median_gap_hours <- if (
                length(gaps_hours) > 0
            ) {

                median(
                    gaps_hours,
                    na.rm = TRUE
                )

            } else {

                NA_real_
            }


            max_gap_hours <- if (
                length(gaps_hours) > 0
            ) {

                max(
                    gaps_hours,
                    na.rm = TRUE
                )

            } else {

                NA_real_
            }


            duplicate_times <- if (
                length(valid_times) > 0
            ) {

                sum(
                    duplicated(
                        valid_times
                    )
                )

            } else {

                NA_integer_
            }


            # -------------------------------------------------------------
            # Geographic coordinates
            # -------------------------------------------------------------

            max_jump_km <- NA_real_

            p99_jump_km <- NA_real_

            lon_span <- NA_real_
            lat_span <- NA_real_

            x_span <- NA_real_
            y_span <- NA_real_


            if (
                !is.na(lon_col) &&
                !is.na(lat_col)
            ) {

                lon <- safe_numeric(
                    group[[lon_col]]
                )

                lat <- safe_numeric(
                    group[[lat_col]]
                )


                lon_span <- diff(
                    range(
                        lon,
                        na.rm = TRUE
                    )
                )


                lat_span <- diff(
                    range(
                        lat,
                        na.rm = TRUE
                    )
                )


                valid_coord <- (
                    is.finite(lon) &
                    is.finite(lat)
                )


                lon2 <- lon[
                    valid_coord
                ]

                lat2 <- lat[
                    valid_coord
                ]


                if (
                    length(lon2) > 1
                ) {

                    jumps <- haversine_km(

                        lon2[
                            -length(lon2)
                        ],

                        lat2[
                            -length(lat2)
                        ],

                        lon2[
                            -1
                        ],

                        lat2[
                            -1
                        ]
                    )


                    max_jump_km <- max(
                        jumps,
                        na.rm = TRUE
                    )


                    p99_jump_km <- quantile(
                        jumps,
                        probs = 0.99,
                        na.rm = TRUE,
                        names = FALSE
                    )
                }
            }


            # -------------------------------------------------------------
            # Projected coordinates
            # -------------------------------------------------------------

            if (
                !is.na(x_col) &&
                !is.na(y_col)
            ) {

                x <- safe_numeric(
                    group[[x_col]]
                )

                y <- safe_numeric(
                    group[[y_col]]
                )


                x_span <- diff(
                    range(
                        x,
                        na.rm = TRUE
                    )
                )


                y_span <- diff(
                    range(
                        y,
                        na.rm = TRUE
                    )
                )
            }


            tibble(

                source_file =
                    basename(
                        file
                    ),

                id =
                    id,

                phase =
                    phase,

                n_fixes =
                    nrow(
                        group
                    ),

                n_unique_times =
                    length(
                        unique(
                            valid_times
                        )
                    ),

                duplicate_times =
                    duplicate_times,

                start_time =
                    start_time,

                end_time =
                    end_time,

                duration_days =
                    duration_days,

                median_gap_hours =
                    median_gap_hours,

                max_gap_hours =
                    max_gap_hours,

                longitude_span =
                    lon_span,

                latitude_span =
                    lat_span,

                max_sequential_jump_km =
                    max_jump_km,

                p99_sequential_jump_km =
                    p99_jump_km,

                projected_x_span =
                    x_span,

                projected_y_span =
                    y_span
            )
        }
    )


    bind_rows(
        results
    )
}

# =============================================================================
# CREATE INDIVIDUAL TRACK PLOTS
#
# IMPORTANT:
# We create ONE plot per deer / phase.
#
# This allows:
#   - each animal to have its own spatial extent
#   - coord_equal() to preserve real geometry
#   - no conflict between free facet scales and fixed coordinate ratio
#
# This is preferable for diagnosing unusually large AKDE estimates.
# =============================================================================

plot_target_tracks <- function(
    file
) {

    if (
        !file.exists(
            file
        )
    ) {

        return(
            list()
        )
    }


    cat(
        "\nCreating track plots from:",
        basename(file),
        "\n"
    )


    data <- read_csv(
        file,
        show_col_types = FALSE
    )


    # =========================================================================
    # Find relevant columns
    # =========================================================================

    id_col <- find_column(
        data,
        c(
            "id",
            "deer_id",
            "identity",
            "animal_id"
        )
    )


    if (
        is.na(
            id_col
        )
    ) {

        cat(
            "  No ID column found.\n"
        )

        return(
            list()
        )
    }


    phase_col <- find_column(
        data,
        c(
            "phase",
            "migration_phase",
            "movement_phase"
        )
    )


    lon_col <- find_column(
        data,
        c(
            "longitude",
            "lon",
            "long"
        )
    )


    lat_col <- find_column(
        data,
        c(
            "latitude",
            "lat"
        )
    )


    x_col <- find_column(
        data,
        c(
            "x",
            "utm_x",
            "easting"
        )
    )


    y_col <- find_column(
        data,
        c(
            "y",
            "utm_y",
            "northing"
        )
    )


    time_col <- find_column(
        data,
        c(
            "timestamp",
            "datetime",
            "date_time",
            "date",
            "Date"
        )
    )


    # =========================================================================
    # Standardize deer IDs and keep focal animals
    # =========================================================================

    data <- data %>%

        mutate(

            diagnostic_id =
                standardize_id(
                    .data[[id_col]]
                )
        ) %>%

        filter(
            diagnostic_id %in% TARGETS$id
        )


    if (
        nrow(
            data
        ) == 0
    ) {

        cat(
            "  No focal deer found in this file.\n"
        )

        return(
            list()
        )
    }


    # =========================================================================
    # Phase label
    # =========================================================================

    if (
        !is.na(
            phase_col
        )
    ) {

        data$diagnostic_phase <- as.character(
            data[[phase_col]]
        )

    } else {

        data$diagnostic_phase <- "Resident"
    }


    # =========================================================================
    # Parse time if available
    #
    # This helps make geom_path() follow chronological order.
    # =========================================================================

    if (
        !is.na(
            time_col
        )
    ) {

        data$diagnostic_time <-
            parse_datetime_flexible(
                data[[time_col]]
            )

    } else {

        data$diagnostic_time <-
            as.POSIXct(
                NA
            )
    }


    # =========================================================================
    # Split into deer / phase groups
    # =========================================================================

    split_key <- interaction(
        data$diagnostic_id,
        data$diagnostic_phase,
        drop = TRUE
    )


    grouped_data <- split(
        data,
        split_key
    )


    plots <- list()


    # =========================================================================
    # Plot each deer / phase separately
    # =========================================================================

    for (
        group_name in names(
            grouped_data
        )
    ) {

        group <- grouped_data[[group_name]]


        id <- unique(
            group$diagnostic_id
        )[1]


        phase <- unique(
            group$diagnostic_phase
        )[1]


        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Sort chronologically
        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

        if (
            any(
                !is.na(
                    group$diagnostic_time
                )
            )
        ) {

            group <- group %>%

                arrange(
                    diagnostic_time
                )
        }


        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Nice panel title
        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

        if (
            phase == "Resident"
        ) {

            plot_title <- paste0(
                id,
                " | Resident"
            )

        } else {

            plot_title <- paste0(
                id,
                " | Phase ",
                phase
            )
        }


        # =====================================================================
        # Longitude / latitude plot
        # =====================================================================

        if (
            !is.na(
                lon_col
            ) &&
            !is.na(
                lat_col
            )
        ) {

            group <- group %>%

                mutate(

                    diagnostic_lon =
                        suppressWarnings(
                            as.numeric(
                                .data[[lon_col]]
                            )
                        ),

                    diagnostic_lat =
                        suppressWarnings(
                            as.numeric(
                                .data[[lat_col]]
                            )
                        )
                ) %>%

                filter(
                    is.finite(
                        diagnostic_lon
                    ),
                    is.finite(
                        diagnostic_lat
                    )
                )


            if (
                nrow(
                    group
                ) < 2
            ) {

                next
            }


            p <- ggplot(

                group,

                aes(
                    x = diagnostic_lon,
                    y = diagnostic_lat
                )
            ) +

                geom_path(
                    alpha = 0.55,
                    linewidth = 0.45
                ) +

                geom_point(
                    alpha = 0.65,
                    size = 0.8
                ) +

                # -------------------------------------------------------------
                # IMPORTANT:
                # Because this is now ONE animal/phase per plot,
                # coord_equal() is safe and preserves spatial geometry.
                # -------------------------------------------------------------

                coord_equal() +

                theme_bw(
                    base_size = 13
                ) +

                labs(

                    title =
                        plot_title,

                    subtitle =
                        paste0(
                            basename(file),
                            " | n = ",
                            format(
                                nrow(group),
                                big.mark = ","
                            ),
                            " fixes"
                        ),

                    x =
                        "Longitude",

                    y =
                        "Latitude"
                )


            plots[[paste0(id, "_", phase)]] <- p


            next
        }


        # =====================================================================
        # Projected x/y plot
        # =====================================================================

        if (
            !is.na(
                x_col
            ) &&
            !is.na(
                y_col
            )
        ) {

            group <- group %>%

                mutate(

                    diagnostic_x =
                        suppressWarnings(
                            as.numeric(
                                .data[[x_col]]
                            )
                        ),

                    diagnostic_y =
                        suppressWarnings(
                            as.numeric(
                                .data[[y_col]]
                            )
                        )
                ) %>%

                filter(
                    is.finite(
                        diagnostic_x
                    ),
                    is.finite(
                        diagnostic_y
                    )
                )


            if (
                nrow(
                    group
                ) < 2
            ) {

                next
            }


            p <- ggplot(

                group,

                aes(
                    x = diagnostic_x,
                    y = diagnostic_y
                )
            ) +

                geom_path(
                    alpha = 0.55,
                    linewidth = 0.45
                ) +

                geom_point(
                    alpha = 0.65,
                    size = 0.8
                ) +

                coord_equal() +

                theme_bw(
                    base_size = 13
                ) +

                labs(

                    title =
                        plot_title,

                    subtitle =
                        paste0(
                            basename(file),
                            " | n = ",
                            format(
                                nrow(group),
                                big.mark = ","
                            ),
                            " fixes"
                        ),

                    x =
                        x_col,

                    y =
                        y_col
                )


            plots[[paste0(id, "_", phase)]] <- p
        }
    }


    return(
        plots
    )
}


# =============================================================================
# RUN TRACK PLOTTING
# =============================================================================

for (
    file in TELEMETRY_FILES
) {

    track_plots <- plot_target_tracks(
        file
    )


    if (
        length(
            track_plots
        ) == 0
    ) {

        next
    }


    # =========================================================================
    # Create subdirectory corresponding to source file
    # =========================================================================

    source_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(
        basename(
            file
        )
    )


    source_output_dir <- file.path(
        OUT_DIR,
        paste0(
            "TRACKS_",
            source_name
        )
    )


    dir.create(
        source_output_dir,
        recursive = TRUE,
        showWarnings = FALSE
    )


    # =========================================================================
    # Save each deer / phase separately
    # =========================================================================

    for (
        plot_name in names(
            track_plots
        )
    ) {

        p <- track_plots[[plot_name]]


        safe_plot_name <- gsub(
            "[^A-Za-z0-9_-]",
            "_",
            plot_name
        )


        output_file <- file.path(

            source_output_dir,

            paste0(
                safe_plot_name,
                ".png"
            )
        )


        ggsave(

            filename =
                output_file,

            plot =
                p,

            width =
                8,

            height =
                7,

            dpi =
                300
        )


        cat(
            "Saved:",
            output_file,
            "\n"
        )
    }
}
```

```{r}
    ),

  )
}


# =============================================================================

) {

  resident <- resident_rebuilt

  cat(
    "\nUsing REBUILT resident AKDE file.\n"

} else if (
  nrow(resident_original) > 0 &&
  ncol(resident_original) > 0
) {

  resident <- resident_original

  cat(
    "\nUsing ORIGINAL resident AKDE file.\n"
  )


} else {

  resident <- tibble()

  cat(
    "\nWARNING: BOTH resident CSV files are empty/unusable.\n"
  )
}


# =============================================================================
# SEARCH ALL COLUMNS FOR A43
# =============================================================================

if (
  nrow(resident) > 0
) {

  a43_columns <- c()


  for (col in names(resident)) {

    values <- as.character(
      resident[[col]]
    )


    if (
      any(
        trimws(values) == "A43",
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    ) {

      a43_columns <- c(
        a43_columns,
        col
      )
    }
  }


  cat(
    "\nColumns containing A43:\n"
  )

  print(
    a43_columns
  )


  if (
    length(a43_columns) > 0
  ) {

    res_id_col <- a43_columns[1]


    A43 <- resident %>%

      filter(
        trimws(
          as.character(
            .data[[res_id_col]]
          )
        ) == "A43"
      )


    cat(
      "\nA43 rows:",
      nrow(A43),
      "\n"
    )


    cat(
      "\nA43 column<LOCAL_PATH>"
    )

    print(
      names(A43)
    )


    cat(
      "\nA43 AKDE dat<LOCAL_PATH>"
    )

    print(
      A43,
      n = Inf,
      width = Inf
    )
  }
}
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# DIAGNOSE A43 "RDS" FILE FORMAT
# =============================================================================

A43_path <- paste0(
  "<LOCAL_PATH>",
  "resident_UD_lists_by_id/",
  "A43_UD_list.rds"
)


# =============================================================================
# 1. BASIC FILE INFORMATION
# =============================================================================

cat(
  "\n",
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n",
  "FILE INFORMATION\n",
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)

print(
  file.info(A43_path)
)


# =============================================================================
# 2. READ FIRST 64 RAW BYTES
#
# This tells us what type of file this actually is.
# =============================================================================

con <- file(
  A43_path,
  open = "rb"
)

header_raw <- readBin(
  con,
  what = "raw",
  n = 64
)

close(con)


cat(
  "\nFirst 64 bytes (hex):\n"
)

print(
  paste(
    sprintf(
      "%02x",
      as.integer(header_raw)
    ),
    collapse = " "
  )
)


# =============================================================================
# 3. TRY TO DISPLAY PRINTABLE HEADER TEXT
# =============================================================================

header_int <- as.integer(
  header_raw
)


header_chars <- ifelse(
  header_int >= 32 &
  header_int <= 126,
  rawToChar(
    as.raw(header_int),
    multiple = TRUE
  ),
  "."
)


cat(
  "\nApproximate printable heade<LOCAL_PATH>"
)

cat(
  paste(
    header_chars,
    collapse = ""
  ),
  "\n"
)


# =============================================================================
# 4. ASK macOS WHAT IT THINKS THE FILE IS
# =============================================================================

cat(
  "\n",
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n",
  "macOS FILE IDENTIFICATION\n",
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)


file_type <- tryCatch(

  system2(
    "file",
    args = shQuote(A43_path),
    stdout = TRUE,
    stderr = TRUE
  ),

  error = function(e) {
    paste(
      "Could not run file command:",
      e$message
    )
  }
)


print(
  file_type
)


# =============================================================================
# 5. TRY readRDS SAFELY
# =============================================================================

cat(
  "\n",
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n",
  "TRY readRDS()\n",
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)


rds_test <- tryCatch(

  {

    x <- readRDS(
      A43_path
    )

    cat(
      "SUCCESS with readRDS()\n"
    )

    x
  },

  error = function(e) {

    cat(
      "FAILE<LOCAL_PATH>",
      e$message,
      "\n"
    )

    NULL
  }
)


# =============================================================================
# 6. TRY load()
#
# VERY IMPORTANT:
# Do this in a temporary environment so nothing contaminates your workspace.
#
# If the file was created with save() instead of saveRDS(), this may work.
# =============================================================================

cat(
  "\n",
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n",
  "TRY load()\n",
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)


temp_env <- new.env()


load_test <- tryCatch(

  {

    loaded_names <- load(
      A43_path,
      envir = temp_env
    )


    cat(
      "SUCCESS with load()\n"
    )


    cat(
      "Objects loade<LOCAL_PATH>"
    )


    print(
      loaded_names
    )


    loaded_names
  },

  error = function(e) {

    cat(
      "FAILE<LOCAL_PATH>",
      e$message,
      "\n"
    )

    NULL
  }
)


# =============================================================================
# 7. IF load() WORKED, INSPECT THE OBJECTS
# =============================================================================

if (
  !is.null(load_test)
) {

  cat(
    "\n",
    paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
    "\n",
    "OBJECTS FOUND IN FILE\n",
    paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
    "\n"
  )


  for (object_name in load_test) {

    object <- get(
      object_name,
      envir = temp_env
    )


    cat(
      "\nOBJECT:",
      object_name,
      "\n"
    )


    cat(

    )

    )

    print(
      length(object)
    )


    cat(
      "Name<LOCAL_PATH>"
    )

    print(
      head(
        names(object),

      )
    )


    cat(
      "Structur<LOCAL_PATH>"
    )

    str(
      object,
      max.level = 2
    )
  }
}


# =============================================================================
# 8. MD5 HASH

# Useful if we later compare this file against another copy.
# =============================================================================

  "\n",

  "\n",
  "MD5\n",
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),

)


print(
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# LIGHTWEIGHT AKDE FILE DIAGNOSTIC
#
# DOES NOT load any RDS objects.
# Only examines:
#
#   - file names
#   - file sizes
#   - whether files are exactly 4 MiB
#
# =============================================================================


base_dir <- "<LOCAL_PATH>"


resident_dir <- file.path(
  base_dir,
  "resident_UD_lists_by_id"
)


migratory_dir <- file.path(
  base_dir,
  "migratory_UD_lists_by_id_phase"
)


# =============================================================================
# GET REAL RDS FILES
#
# Ignore macOS ._ metadata files.
# =============================================================================

resident_files <- list.files(
  resident_dir,
  pattern = "\\.rds$",
  full.names = TRUE
)


resident_files <- resident_files[
  !grepl(
    "^\\._",
    basename(resident_files)
  )
]


migratory_files <- list.files(
  migratory_dir,
  pattern = "\\.rds$",
  full.names = TRUE
)


migratory_files <- migratory_files[
  !grepl(
    "^\\._",
    basename(migratory_files)
  )
]


# =============================================================================
# FILE SIZE TABLE ONLY
# =============================================================================

resident_sizes <- data.frame(

  file = basename(
    resident_files
  ),

  size_bytes = file.info(
    resident_files
  )$size,

  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


resident_sizes$size_MiB <- (
  resident_sizes$size_bytes /
  1024^2
)


resident_sizes$exactly_4_MiB <- (
  resident_sizes$size_bytes ==
  4194304
)


migratory_sizes <- data.frame(

  file = basename(
    migratory_files
  ),

  size_bytes = file.info(
    migratory_files
  )$size,

  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


migratory_sizes$size_MiB <- (
  migratory_sizes$size_bytes /
  1024^2
)


migratory_sizes$exactly_4_MiB <- (
  migratory_sizes$size_bytes ==
  4194304
)


# =============================================================================
# SUMMARY
# =============================================================================

cat(
  "\n",
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "RESIDENT FILE SUMMARY\n"
)

cat(
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "\nFiles:",
  nrow(resident_sizes)
)


cat(
  "\nExactly 4 MiB:",
  sum(
    resident_sizes$exactly_4_MiB
  )
)


cat(
  "\nMinimum size:",
  round(
    min(
      resident_sizes$size_MiB
    ),
    4
  ),
  "MiB"
)


cat(
  "\nMedian size:",
  round(
    median(
      resident_sizes$size_MiB
    ),
    4
  ),
  "MiB"
)


cat(
  "\nMaximum size:",
  round(
    max(
      resident_sizes$size_MiB
    ),
    4
  ),
  "MiB\n"
)


# =============================================================================
# MIGRATORY SUMMARY
# =============================================================================

cat(
  "\n",
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "MIGRATORY FILE SUMMARY\n"
)

cat(
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "\nFiles:",
  nrow(migratory_sizes)
)


cat(
  "\nExactly 4 MiB:",
  sum(
    migratory_sizes$exactly_4_MiB
  )
)


cat(
  "\nMinimum size:",
  round(
    min(
      migratory_sizes$size_MiB
    ),
    4
  ),
  "MiB"
)


cat(
  "\nMedian size:",
  round(
    median(
      migratory_sizes$size_MiB
    ),
    4
  ),
  "MiB"
)


cat(
  "\nMaximum size:",
  round(
    max(
      migratory_sizes$size_MiB
    ),
    4
  ),
  "MiB\n"
)


# =============================================================================
# SHOW RESIDENT FILES
# =============================================================================

cat(
  "\n",
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),

)

cat(
  "RESIDENT FILE SIZES\n"

print(

    ),

cat(

  migratory_sizes[
```

```{r}
      row.names = FALSE
    )
  }
}

```


```{r}
# =============================================================================
# DEEP DIAGNOSTIC OF A43 USING THE VALID RESIDENT AKDE CSV
#
# No RDS loading required.
# =============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(lubridate)


# =============================================================================
# PATHS
# =============================================================================

base_dir <- "<LOCAL_PATH>"


akde_file <- file.path(
  base_dir,
  "resident_AKDE_7day_windows.csv"
)


telemetry_file <- file.path(
  base_dir,
  "resident_telemetry_input_used_for_AKDE.csv"
)


# =============================================================================
# LOAD COMPACT TABLES
# =============================================================================

akde <- read_csv(
  akde_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)


telemetry <- read_csv(
  telemetry_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)


# =============================================================================
# STANDARDIZE DATETIMES
# =============================================================================

akde <- akde %>%
  mutate(
    window_start = as.POSIXct(
      window_start,
      tz = "UTC"
    )
  )


telemetry <- telemetry %>%
  mutate(
    timestamp = as.POSIXct(
      timestamp,
      tz = "UTC"
    )
  )


# =============================================================================
# EXTRACT A43
# =============================================================================

A43 <- akde %>%

  filter(
    id == "A43"
  ) %>%

  arrange(
    window_start
  )


A43_tel <- telemetry %>%

  filter(
    individual.local.identifier == "A43"
  ) %>%

  arrange(
    timestamp
  )


cat(
  "\nA43 AKDE windows:",
  nrow(A43),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "A43 telemetry fixes:",
  nrow(A43_tel),
  "\n"
)


# =============================================================================
# COUNT ACTUAL FIXES IN EVERY 7-DAY WINDOW
# =============================================================================

A43$n_fixes_window <- vapply(

  A43$window_start,

  function(t0) {

    sum(
      A43_tel$timestamp >= t0 &
      A43_tel$timestamp <= t0 + days(7)
    )
  },

  integer(1)
)


# =============================================================================
# CONSECUTIVE WINDOW CHANGES
# =============================================================================

A43 <- A43 %>%

  mutate(

    previous_est =
      lag(est),

    absolute_change =
      est - previous_est,

    ratio_to_previous =
      est / previous_est,

    percent_change =
      (
        est - previous_est
      ) /
      previous_est *
      100,

    previous_n_fixes =
      lag(n_fixes_window)
  )


# =============================================================================
# BASIC DISTRIBUTION
# =============================================================================

cat(
  "\n",
  paste(rep("=", 110), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "A43 AKDE DISTRIBUTION\n"
)

cat(
  paste(rep("=", 110), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)


print(
  summary(
    A43$est
  )
)


cat(
  "\nAKDE estimate quantile<LOCAL_PATH>"
)


print(
  quantile(
    A43$est,
    probs = c(
      0,
      0.01,
      0.05,
      0.25,
      0.50,
      0.75,
      0.95,
      0.99,
      1
    ),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
)


cat(
  "\nFix-count distribution per 7-day windo<LOCAL_PATH>"
)


print(
  summary(
    A43$n_fixes_window
  )
)


# =============================================================================
# BIGGEST ABSOLUTE AKDE ESTIMATES
# =============================================================================

cat(
  "\n",
  paste(rep("=", 110), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "A43 — 20 LARGEST AKDE WINDOWS\n"
)

cat(
  paste(rep("=", 110), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)


print(

  A43 %>%

    arrange(
      desc(est)
    ) %>%

    select(
      window_start,
      n_fixes_window,
      low,
      est,
      high,
      previous_est,
      absolute_change,
      percent_change
    ) %>%

    head(
      20
    ),

  n = 20,
  width = Inf
)


# =============================================================================
# BIGGEST CONSECUTIVE INCREASES
# =============================================================================

cat(
  "\n",
  paste(rep("=", 110), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "A43 — 20 LARGEST CONSECUTIVE INCREASES\n"
)

cat(
  paste(rep("=", 110), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)


print(

  A43 %>%

    filter(
      !is.na(absolute_change)
    ) %>%

    arrange(
      desc(absolute_change)
    ) %>%

    select(
      window_start,
      previous_n_fixes,
      n_fixes_window,
      previous_est,
      est,
      absolute_change,
      percent_change,
      low,
      high
    ) %>%

    head(
      20
    ),

  n = 20,
  width = Inf
)


# =============================================================================
# BIGGEST PERCENTAGE INCREASES
#
# Require previous estimate > 0.01 so tiny denominators
# don't completely dominate the table.
# =============================================================================

cat(
  "\n",
  paste(rep("=", 110), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "A43 — 20 LARGEST PERCENTAGE INCREASES\n"
)

cat(
  paste(rep("=", 110), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)


print(

  A43 %>%

    filter(
      !is.na(percent_change),
      previous_est > 0.01
    ) %>%

    arrange(
      desc(percent_change)
    ) %>%

    select(
      window_start,
      previous_n_fixes,
      n_fixes_window,
      previous_est,
      est,
      absolute_change,
      percent_change,
      low,
      high
    ) %>%

    head(
      20
    ),

  n = 20,
  width = Inf
)


# =============================================================================
# WINDOWS WITH FEWER THAN EXPECTED FIXES
# =============================================================================

cat(
  "\n",
  paste(rep("=", 110), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "A43 — WINDOWS WITH <48 FIXES\n"
)

cat(
  paste(rep("=", 110), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)


print(

  A43 %>%

    filter(
      n_fixes_window < 48
    ) %>%

    select(
      window_start,
      n_fixes_window,
      low,
      est,
      high
    ),

  n = Inf,
  width = Inf
)
```
