```{r}
# =============================================================================
# PRIVACY-SAFE A43 AKDE WINDOW COMPARISON
#
# IMPORTANT:
# - Uses coordinates internally for AKDE fitting.
# - DOES NOT print latitude or longitude.
# - DOES NOT print individual GPS locations.
# - DOES NOT print the complete telemetry object.
# - DOES NOT print the complete ctmm model object.
# =============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ctmm)
library(lubridate)


# =============================================================================
# LOAD TELEMETRY
# =============================================================================

telemetry_file <- paste0(
  "<LOCAL_PATH>",
  "resident_telemetry_input_used_for_AKDE.csv"
)


telemetry <- read_csv(
  telemetry_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    timestamp = as.POSIXct(
      timestamp,
      tz = "UTC"
    )
  )


A43_tel_df <- telemetry %>%
  filter(
    individual.local.identifier == "A43"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    timestamp
  )


# =============================================================================
# CONVERT TO CTMM TELEMETRY
#
# Coordinates remain internal.
# =============================================================================

A43_tel <- as.telemetry(
  A43_tel_df,
  timeformat = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
  timezone = "UTC"
)


# =============================================================================
# TWO WINDOWS WE WANT TO COMPARE
# =============================================================================

t0_1 <- as.POSIXct(
  "2008-07-17 16:00:50",
  tz = "UTC"
)


t0_2 <- as.POSIXct(
  "2008-07-17 22:00:57",
  tz = "UTC"
)


week_sec <- 7 * 24 * 3600


win1 <- A43_tel[
  A43_tel$t >= as.numeric(t0_1) &
  A43_tel$t <= as.numeric(t0_1) + week_sec,
]


win2 <- A43_tel[
  A43_tel$t >= as.numeric(t0_2) &
  A43_tel$t <= as.numeric(t0_2) + week_sec,
]


# =============================================================================
# PRIVACY-SAFE OVERLAP INFORMATION
#
# We calculate timestamps internally but print ONLY counts.
# =============================================================================

times1 <- win1$t
times2 <- win2$t


n_shared <- length(
  intersect(
    times1,
    times2
  )
)


n_removed <- length(
  setdiff(
    times1,
    times2
  )
)


n_added <- length(
  setdiff(
    times2,
    times1
  )
)


shift_hours <- as.numeric(
  difftime(
    t0_2,
    t0_1,
    units = "hours"
  )
)


# =============================================================================
# FIT WINDOW 1
# =============================================================================

v1 <- variogram(
  win1,
  CI = "Gauss"
)


guess1 <- variogram.fit(
  v1,
  name = "GuessBM",
  interactive = FALSE
)


model1 <- ctmm.select(
  win1,
  guess1,
  IC = "BIC"
)


UD1 <- akde(
  win1,
  model1,
  weights = TRUE
)


# =============================================================================
# FIT WINDOW 2
# =============================================================================

v2 <- variogram(
  win2,
  CI = "Gauss"
)


guess2 <- variogram.fit(
  v2,
  name = "GuessBM",
  interactive = FALSE
)


model2 <- ctmm.select(
  win2,
  guess2,
  IC = "BIC"
)


UD2 <- akde(
  win2,
  model2,
  weights = TRUE
)


# =============================================================================
# SAFE AKDE EXTRACTION
# =============================================================================

extract_akde_area <- function(UD) {

  ci <- summary(UD)$CI

  ci_df <- as.data.frame(
    ci
  )

  area_row <- grep(
    "^area",
    rownames(ci_df),
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )


  if (length(area_row) == 0) {

    return(
      data.frame(
        low = NA_real_,
        est = NA_real_,
        high = NA_real_
      )
    )
  }


  data.frame(

    low =
      ci_df[
        area_row[1],
        "low"
      ],

    est =
      ci_df[
        area_row[1],
        "est"
      ],

    high =
      ci_df[
        area_row[1],
        "high"
      ]
  )
}


area1 <- extract_akde_area(
  UD1
)


area2 <- extract_akde_area(
  UD2
)


# =============================================================================
# SAFE MODEL INFORMATION
#
# Do NOT print the whole model.
# =============================================================================

get_model_name <- function(model) {

  if (
    "name" %in% names(model) &&
    !is.null(model$name)
  ) {

    return(
      as.character(
        model$name
      )[1]
    )
  }


  return(
    NA_character_
  )
}


get_tau_safe <- function(model) {

  if (
    "tau" %in% names(model) &&
    !is.null(model$tau)
  ) {

    tau <- as.numeric(
      model$tau
    )


    return(
      paste(
        round(
          tau / 3600,
          4
        ),
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }


  return(
    NA_character_
  )
}


model1_name <- get_model_name(
  model1
)


model2_name <- get_model_name(
  model2
)


model1_tau_hours <- get_tau_safe(
  model1
)


model2_tau_hours <- get_tau_safe(
  model2
)


# =============================================================================
# SAME-MODEL TEST
#
# This is VERY useful:
# fit both windows using Model 1.
# =============================================================================

UD1_same_model <- akde(
  win1,
  model1,
  weights = TRUE
)


UD2_same_model <- tryCatch(

  akde(
    win2,
    model1,
    weights = TRUE
  ),

  error = function(e) {
    NULL
  }
)


area1_same <- extract_akde_area(
  UD1_same_model
)


if (
  !is.null(
    UD2_same_model
  )
) {

  area2_same <- extract_akde_area(
    UD2_same_model
  )

} else {

  area2_same <- data.frame(
    low = NA_real_,
    est = NA_real_,
    high = NA_real_
  )
}


# =============================================================================
# CALCULATE CHANGES
# =============================================================================

independent_ratio <- (
  area2$est /
  area1$est
)


independent_pct_change <- (
  (
    area2$est -
    area1$est
  ) /
  area1$est
) * 100


same_model_ratio <- (
  area2_same$est /
  area1_same$est
)


same_model_pct_change <- (
  (
    area2_same$est -
    area1_same$est
  ) /
  area1_same$est
) * 100


# =============================================================================
# PRINT PRIVACY-SAFE RESULTS
# =============================================================================

cat(
  "\n",
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "PRIVACY-SAFE A43 AKDE DIAGNOSTIC\n"
)

cat(
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "\nWindow shift:",
  round(
    shift_hours,
    3
  ),
  "hours\n"
)


cat(
  "\nWindow 1 fixes:",
  length(win1$t),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Window 2 fixes:",
  length(win2$t),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Shared fixes:",
  n_shared,
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Fixes removed:",
  n_removed,
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Fixes added:",
  n_added,
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "\nPercent of Window 1 retained:",
  round(
    100 *
    n_shared /
    length(win1$t),
    2
  ),
  "%\n"
)


# =============================================================================
# INDEPENDENT MODEL RESULTS
# =============================================================================

cat(
  "\n",
  paste(rep("-", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "INDEPENDENT MODEL FITS\n"
)

cat(
  paste(rep("-", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "\nWindow 1 model:",
  model1_name,
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Window 2 model:",
  model2_name,
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "\nWindow 1 tau (hours):",
  model1_tau_hours,
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Window 2 tau (hours):",
  model2_tau_hours,
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "\nWindow 1 AKD<LOCAL_PATH>"
)


print(
  round(
    area1,
    6
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


cat(
  "\nWindow 2 AKD<LOCAL_PATH>"
)


print(
  round(
    area2,
    6
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


cat(
  "\nWindow 2 / Window 1 ratio:",
  round(
    independent_ratio,
    4
  ),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Percent change:",
  round(
    independent_pct_change,
    2
  ),
  "%\n"
)


# =============================================================================
# SAME MODEL RESULTS
# =============================================================================

cat(
  "\n",
  paste(rep("-", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "SAME MOVEMENT MODEL FOR BOTH WINDOWS\n"
)

cat(
  paste(rep("-", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "\nWindow 1 AKDE using Model 1:\n"
)


print(
  round(
    area1_same,
    6
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


cat(
  "\nWindow 2 AKDE using SAME Model 1:\n"
)


print(
  round(
    area2_same,
    6
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


cat(
  "\nWindow 2 / Window 1 ratio:",
  round(
    same_model_ratio,
    4
  ),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Percent change:",
  round(
    same_model_pct_change,
    2
  ),
  "%\n"
)


# =============================================================================
# MODEL-SELECTION DIAGNOSTIC
# =============================================================================

cat(
  "\n",
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "MODEL-SELECTION DIAGNOSTIC\n"
)

cat(
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)


if (
  is.finite(independent_ratio) &&
  is.finite(same_model_ratio)
) {

  cat(
    "\nIndependent-model AKDE ratio:",
    round(
      independent_ratio,
      4
    ),
    "\n"
  )


  cat(
    "Same-model AKDE ratio:",
    round(
      same_model_ratio,
      4
    ),
    "\n"
  )


  cat(
    "\nDifference between ratios:",
    round(
      independent_ratio -
      same_model_ratio,
      4
    ),
    "\n"
  )
}


cat(
  "\nNo coordinates or individual GPS locations were printed.\n"
)

```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# PRIVACY-SAFE DIAGNOSTIC:
# DID THE NEW FIXES CAUSE THE AKDE EXPLOSION?
#
# No latitude or longitude is printed.
# Only distance summaries are shown.
# =============================================================================

library(sf)
library(dplyr)


# =============================================================================
# ORIGINAL A43 DATAFRAME
# =============================================================================

A43_private <- A43_tel_df %>%

  arrange(
    timestamp
  )


# =============================================================================
# DEFINE THE TWO TIME WINDOWS
# =============================================================================

window1_df <- A43_private %>%

  filter(
    timestamp >= t0_1,
    timestamp <= t0_1 + days(7)
  )


window2_df <- A43_private %>%

  filter(
    timestamp >= t0_2,
    timestamp <= t0_2 + days(7)
  )


# =============================================================================
# IDENTIFY SHARED / REMOVED / ADDED OBSERVATIONS BY TIMESTAMP
# =============================================================================

shared_times <- intersect(
  window1_df$timestamp,
  window2_df$timestamp
)


removed_times <- setdiff(
  window1_df$timestamp,
  window2_df$timestamp
)


added_times <- setdiff(
  window2_df$timestamp,
  window1_df$timestamp
)


shared_df <- window2_df %>%

  filter(
    timestamp %in% shared_times
  )


added_df <- window2_df %>%

  filter(
    timestamp %in% added_times
  )


removed_df <- window1_df %>%

  filter(
    timestamp %in% removed_times
  )


# =============================================================================
# CONVERT TO SF INTERNALLY
#
# Coordinates are never printed.
# =============================================================================

to_sf_private <- function(df) {

  st_as_sf(
    df,
    coords = c(
      "location.long",
      "location.lat"
    ),
    crs = 4326,
    remove = FALSE
  ) %>%

    st_transform(
      5070
    )
}


shared_sf <- to_sf_private(
  shared_df
)


added_sf <- to_sf_private(
  added_df
)


removed_sf <- to_sf_private(
  removed_df
)


win1_sf <- to_sf_private(
  window1_df
)


win2_sf <- to_sf_private(
  window2_df
)


# =============================================================================
# HELPER: MAXIMUM PAIRWISE DISTANCE WITHIN A WINDOW
# =============================================================================

max_pairwise_distance <- function(x) {

  D <- st_distance(
    x
  )


  max(
    as.numeric(D),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
}


# =============================================================================
# HELPER:
# DISTANCE OF EACH ADDED POINT TO NEAREST SHARED POINT
# =============================================================================

if (
  nrow(added_sf) > 0 &&
  nrow(shared_sf) > 0
) {

  added_to_shared <- st_distance(
    added_sf,
    shared_sf
  )


  added_nearest_m <- apply(

    added_to_shared,

    1,

    function(x) {
      min(
        as.numeric(x),
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    }
  )

} else {

  added_nearest_m <- numeric(0)
}


# =============================================================================
# DISTANCE OF REMOVED POINT TO SHARED DATA
# =============================================================================

if (
  nrow(removed_sf) > 0 &&
  nrow(shared_sf) > 0
) {

  removed_to_shared <- st_distance(
    removed_sf,
    shared_sf
  )


  removed_nearest_m <- apply(

    removed_to_shared,

    1,

    function(x) {
      min(
        as.numeric(x),
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    }
  )

} else {

  removed_nearest_m <- numeric(0)
}


# =============================================================================
# TEMPORAL STEP DISTANCES
#
# These reveal whether the newly entering points correspond to
# unusually large movements.
# =============================================================================

step_distance_summary <- function(df) {

  if (
    nrow(df) < 2
  ) {

    return(
      data.frame(
        n_steps = 0,
        median_step_m = NA_real_,
        max_step_m = NA_real_
      )
    )
  }


  x <- to_sf_private(
    df
  )


  g <- st_geometry(
    x
  )


  steps <- sapply(

    seq_len(
      length(g) - 1
    ),

    function(i) {

      as.numeric(
        st_distance(
          g[i],
          g[i + 1],
          by_element = TRUE
        )
      )
    }
  )


  data.frame(

    n_steps =
      length(steps),

    median_step_m =
      median(
        steps,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    max_step_m =
      max(
        steps,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
  )
}


step1 <- step_distance_summary(
  window1_df
)


step2 <- step_distance_summary(
  window2_df
)


# =============================================================================
# PRINT PRIVACY-SAFE RESULTS
# =============================================================================

cat(
  "\n",
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "PRIVACY-SAFE SPATIAL DIAGNOSTIC\n"
)

cat(
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "\nWindow 1 fixes:",
  nrow(window1_df),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Window 2 fixes:",
  nrow(window2_df),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Shared:",
  length(shared_times),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Removed:",
  length(removed_times),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Added:",
  length(added_times),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "\nMaximum separation among Window 1 fixes:",
  round(
    max_pairwise_distance(
      win1_sf
    ),
    2
  ),
  "m\n"
)


cat(
  "Maximum separation among Window 2 fixes:",
  round(
    max_pairwise_distance(
      win2_sf
    ),
    2
  ),
  "m\n"
)


cat(
  "\nNearest distance from each ADDED fix to any shared fi<LOCAL_PATH>"
)


print(
  round(
    added_nearest_m,
    2
  )
)


cat(
  "\nNearest distance from REMOVED fix(es) to any shared fi<LOCAL_PATH>"
)


print(
  round(
    removed_nearest_m,
    2
  )
)


cat(
  "\nWindow 1 step-distance summar<LOCAL_PATH>"
)


print(
  round(
    step1,
    2
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


cat(
  "\nWindow 2 step-distance summar<LOCAL_PATH>"
)


print(
  round(
    step2,
    2
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


cat(
  "\nNo coordinates were printed.\n"
)
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# PRIVACY-SAFE TEST:
# ARE TEMPORAL GAPS / AKDE WEIGHTS CAUSING THE INSTABILITY?
#
# No coordinates are printed.
# =============================================================================


# =============================================================================
# HELPER: TEMPORAL GAP SUMMARY
# =============================================================================

gap_summary <- function(win) {

  times <- sort(
    as.numeric(
      win$t
    )
  )


  gaps_hours <- diff(
    times
  ) / 3600


  data.frame(

    n_fixes =
      length(times),

    n_gaps =
      length(gaps_hours),

    min_gap_hours =
      min(
        gaps_hours,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    median_gap_hours =
      median(
        gaps_hours,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    mean_gap_hours =
      mean(
        gaps_hours,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    max_gap_hours =
      max(
        gaps_hours,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    gaps_over_6h =
      sum(
        gaps_hours > 6,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    gaps_over_9h =
      sum(
        gaps_hours > 9,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    gaps_over_12h =
      sum(
        gaps_hours > 12,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    gaps_over_24h =
      sum(
        gaps_hours > 24,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
  )
}


gap1 <- gap_summary(
  win1
)


gap2 <- gap_summary(
  win2
)


# =============================================================================
# SAME MODEL, WEIGHTS = FALSE
#
# We already tested both windows using model1 with weights = TRUE.
# Now turn weighting off.
# =============================================================================

UD1_unweighted <- tryCatch(

  akde(
    win1,
    model1,
    weights = FALSE
  ),

  error = function(e) {

    message(
      "Window 1 unweighted AKDE failed: ",
      e$message
    )

    NULL
  }
)


UD2_unweighted <- tryCatch(

  akde(
    win2,
    model1,
    weights = FALSE
  ),

  error = function(e) {

    message(
      "Window 2 unweighted AKDE failed: ",
      e$message
    )

    NULL
  }
)


# =============================================================================
# EXTRACT AREA
# =============================================================================

if (!is.null(UD1_unweighted)) {

  area1_unweighted <- extract_akde_area(
    UD1_unweighted
  )

} else {

  area1_unweighted <- data.frame(
    low = NA_real_,
    est = NA_real_,
    high = NA_real_
  )
}


if (!is.null(UD2_unweighted)) {

  area2_unweighted <- extract_akde_area(
    UD2_unweighted
  )

} else {

  area2_unweighted <- data.frame(
    low = NA_real_,
    est = NA_real_,
    high = NA_real_
  )
}


# =============================================================================
# CALCULATE RATIOS
# =============================================================================

weighted_ratio <- (
  area2_same$est /
  area1_same$est
)


unweighted_ratio <- (
  area2_unweighted$est /
  area1_unweighted$est
)


weighted_pct <- (
  weighted_ratio - 1
) * 100


unweighted_pct <- (
  unweighted_ratio - 1
) * 100


# =============================================================================
# PRINT
# =============================================================================

cat(
  "\n",
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "TEMPORAL GAP DIAGNOSTIC\n"
)

cat(
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "\nWindow 1:\n"
)

print(
  round(
    gap1,
    3
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


cat(
  "\nWindow 2:\n"
)

print(
  round(
    gap2,
    3
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


cat(
  "\n",
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "WEIGHTED VS UNWEIGHTED AKDE\n"
)

cat(
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "\nWEIGHTED — Window 1:\n"
)

print(
  round(
    area1_same,
    6
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


cat(
  "\nWEIGHTED — Window 2:\n"
)

print(
  round(
    area2_same,
    6
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


cat(
  "\nWeighted Window 2 / Window 1 ratio:",
  round(
    weighted_ratio,
    4
  ),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Weighted percent change:",
  round(
    weighted_pct,
    2
  ),
  "%\n"
)


cat(
  "\nUNWEIGHTED — Window 1:\n"
)

print(
  round(
    area1_unweighted,
    6
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


cat(
  "\nUNWEIGHTED — Window 2:\n"
)

print(
  round(
    area2_unweighted,
    6
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


cat(
  "\nUnweighted Window 2 / Window 1 ratio:",
  round(
    unweighted_ratio,
    4
  ),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Unweighted percent change:",
  round(
    unweighted_pct,
    2
  ),
  "%\n"
)


cat(
  "\nNo coordinates were printed.\n"
)
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# REPAIR ALL EXISTING AKDE RESULTS
#
# PURPOSE
# -------
# Re-extract every existing AKDE from saved UD objects using:
#
#     summary(UD, units = FALSE)
#
# This returns area in square meters.
#
# All areas are then explicitly converted:
#
#     m² -> km²
#
# NO movement model is refitted.
# NO variogram is refitted.
# NO AKDE is recalculated.
#
# Existing RDS files are processed ONE AT A TIME to control memory use.
# =============================================================================

library(ctmm)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)


# =============================================================================
# PATHS
# =============================================================================

RESIDENT_BASE <- "<LOCAL_PATH>"

MIGRATORY_BASE <- "<LOCAL_PATH>"


RESIDENT_RDS_DIR <- file.path(
  RESIDENT_BASE,
  "resident_UD_lists_by_id"
)


MIGRATORY_RDS_DIR <- file.path(
  MIGRATORY_BASE,
  "migratory_UD_lists_by_id_phase"
)


RESIDENT_OLD_WINDOWS <- file.path(
  RESIDENT_BASE,
  "resident_AKDE_7day_windows.csv"
)


MIGRATORY_OLD_WINDOWS <- file.path(
  MIGRATORY_BASE,
  "migratory_AKDE_7day_windows.csv"
)


# =============================================================================
# NEW OUTPUT FILES
#
# DO NOT overwrite the original files yet.
# =============================================================================

RESIDENT_CORRECTED_OUT <- file.path(
  RESIDENT_BASE,
  "resident_AKDE_7day_windows_CORRECTED_km2.csv"
)


MIGRATORY_CORRECTED_OUT <- file.path(
  MIGRATORY_BASE,
  "migratory_AKDE_7day_windows_CORRECTED_km2.csv"
)


VALIDATION_OUT <- file.path(
  RESIDENT_BASE,
  "AKDE_unit_repair_validation.csv"
)


# =============================================================================
# STANDARDIZED EXTRACTION FUNCTION
# =============================================================================

extract_akde_area_km2 <- function(UD) {

  ci <- summary(
    UD,
    units = FALSE
  )$CI


  if (is.null(ci)) {

    stop(
      "summary(UD, units = FALSE)$CI returned NULL."
    )
  }


  area_idx <- grep(
    "^area",
    rownames(ci),
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )


  if (length(area_idx) != 1) {

    stop(
      paste0(
        "Expected exactly one area row; found ",
        length(area_idx)
      )
    )
  }


  source_unit <- rownames(
    ci
  )[area_idx]


  if (
    !grepl(
      "square meters",
      source_unit,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
  ) {

    stop(
      paste0(
        "Unexpected source unit: ",
        source_unit
      )
    )
  }


  values <- as.numeric(
    ci[
      area_idx,
      c(
        "low",
        "est",
        "high"
      )
    ]
  )


  tibble(

    low =
      values[1] / 1e6,

    est =
      values[2] / 1e6,

    high =
      values[3] / 1e6,

    source_unit =
      source_unit,

    akde_unit =
      "square_kilometers"
  )
}


# =============================================================================
# READ ORIGINAL WINDOW TABLES
#
# These provide window_start and group identifiers.
#
# Their existing low/est/high values are NOT trusted.
# =============================================================================

resident_old <- read_csv(
  RESIDENT_OLD_WINDOWS,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    id = as.character(id)
  )


migratory_old <- read_csv(
  MIGRATORY_OLD_WINDOWS,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    id = as.character(id),
    id_phase = as.character(id_phase)
  )


cat(
  "\nResident original window rows:",
  nrow(resident_old),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Migratory original window rows:",
  nrow(migratory_old),
  "\n"
)


# =============================================================================
# GET RDS FILES
# =============================================================================

resident_files <- list.files(

  RESIDENT_RDS_DIR,

  pattern = "_UD_list\\.rds$",

  full.names = TRUE
)


resident_files <- resident_files[
  !grepl(
    "^\\._",
    basename(resident_files)
  )
]


migratory_files <- list.files(

  MIGRATORY_RDS_DIR,

  pattern = "_UD_list\\.rds$",

  full.names = TRUE
)


migratory_files <- migratory_files[
  !grepl(
    "^\\._",
    basename(migratory_files)
  )
]


cat(
  "\nResident RDS files:",
  length(resident_files),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Migratory RDS files:",
  length(migratory_files),
  "\n"
)


# =============================================================================
# STORAGE FOR COMPACT OUTPUT ONLY
#
# The giant UD objects themselves are removed after each animal.
# =============================================================================

resident_fixed_parts <- list()

migratory_fixed_parts <- list()

validation <- list()


# =============================================================================
# REPAIR RESIDENT AKDE
# =============================================================================

cat(
  "\n",
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "REPAIRING RESIDENT AKDE\n"
)

cat(
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)


for (i in seq_along(resident_files)) {

  file <- resident_files[i]


  deer_id <- basename(
    file
  ) %>%
    str_remove(
      "_UD_list\\.rds$"
    )


  cat(
    "\n[",
    i,
    "/",
    length(resident_files),
    "] Resident ID:",
    deer_id,
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )


  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Existing metadata for this deer
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  old_group <- resident_old %>%

    filter(
      id == deer_id
    ) %>%

    arrange(
      window_start
    )


  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Load ONE deer
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ud_list <- readRDS(
    file
  )


  n_ud <- length(
    ud_list
  )


  n_old <- nrow(
    old_group
  )


  cat(
    "Saved UDs:",
    n_ud,
    "| Existing window rows:",
    n_old,
    "\n"
  )


  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # HARD ALIGNMENT CHECK
  #
  # The saved UDs and old window rows must match exactly.
  # We do NOT guess if they differ.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  if (n_ud != n_old) {

    warning(
      paste0(
        "COUNT MISMATCH FOR RESIDENT ",
        deer_id,
        ": ",
        n_ud,
        " UDs vs ",
        n_old,
        " window rows. SKIPPING."
      )
    )


    validation[[length(validation) + 1]] <- tibble(

      dataset = "resident",

      group = deer_id,

      n_ud = n_ud,

      n_window_rows = n_old,

      status = "COUNT_MISMATCH"
    )


    rm(
      ud_list
    )

    gc()

    next
  }


  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Extract all areas in km²
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  corrected_area <- map_dfr(

    seq_along(
      ud_list
    ),

    function(j) {

      area <- extract_akde_area_km2(
        ud_list[[j]]
      )


      area %>%
        mutate(
          window_index = j
        )
    }
  )


  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Keep original mixed values for auditing,
  # but corrected low/est/high become the real values.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  corrected_group <- old_group %>%

    mutate(
      window_index = row_number()
    ) %>%

    rename(

      old_low_mixed_units =
        low,

      old_est_mixed_units =
        est,

      old_high_mixed_units =
        high
    ) %>%

    select(
      id,
      window_start,
      window_index,
      old_low_mixed_units,
      old_est_mixed_units,
      old_high_mixed_units
    ) %>%

    left_join(
      corrected_area,
      by = "window_index"
    ) %>%

    select(
      id,
      window_start,
      low,
      est,
      high,
      akde_unit,
      source_unit,
      old_low_mixed_units,
      old_est_mixed_units,
      old_high_mixed_units
    )


  resident_fixed_parts[[length(resident_fixed_parts) + 1]] <- corrected_group


  validation[[length(validation) + 1]] <- tibble(

    dataset = "resident",

    group = deer_id,

    n_ud = n_ud,

    n_window_rows = n_old,

    status = "CORRECTED"
  )


  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # MEMORY CLEANUP
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  rm(
    ud_list,
    corrected_area,
    corrected_group,
    old_group
  )

  gc()
}


# =============================================================================
# COMBINE RESIDENT RESULTS
# =============================================================================

resident_corrected <- bind_rows(
  resident_fixed_parts
)


# =============================================================================
# REPAIR MIGRATORY AKDE
# =============================================================================

cat(
  "\n",
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "REPAIRING MIGRATORY AKDE\n"
)

cat(
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)


for (i in seq_along(migratory_files)) {

  file <- migratory_files[i]


  id_phase <- basename(
    file
  ) %>%
    str_remove(
      "_UD_list\\.rds$"
    )


  cat(
    "\n[",
    i,
    "/",
    length(migratory_files),
    "] Migratory group:",
    id_phase,
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )


  old_group <- migratory_old %>%

    filter(
      id_phase == !!id_phase
    ) %>%

    arrange(
      window_start
    )


  ud_list <- readRDS(
    file
  )


  n_ud <- length(
    ud_list
  )


  n_old <- nrow(
    old_group
  )


  cat(
    "Saved UDs:",
    n_ud,
    "| Existing window rows:",
    n_old,
    "\n"
  )


  if (n_ud != n_old) {

    warning(
      paste0(
        "COUNT MISMATCH FOR MIGRATORY ",
        id_phase,
        ": ",
        n_ud,
        " UDs vs ",
        n_old,
        " window rows. SKIPPING."
      )
    )


    validation[[length(validation) + 1]] <- tibble(

      dataset = "migratory",

      group = id_phase,

      n_ud = n_ud,

      n_window_rows = n_old,

      status = "COUNT_MISMATCH"
    )


    rm(
      ud_list
    )

    gc()

    next
  }


  corrected_area <- map_dfr(

    seq_along(
      ud_list
    ),

    function(j) {

      area <- extract_akde_area_km2(
        ud_list[[j]]
      )


      area %>%
        mutate(
          window_index = j
        )
    }
  )


  corrected_group <- old_group %>%

    arrange(
      window_start
    ) %>%

    mutate(
      window_index = row_number()
    ) %>%

    rename(

      old_low_mixed_units =
        low,

      old_est_mixed_units =
        est,

      old_high_mixed_units =
        high
    ) %>%

    select(
      id,
      phase,
      id_phase,
      window_start,
      window_index,
      old_low_mixed_units,
      old_est_mixed_units,
      old_high_mixed_units
    ) %>%

    left_join(
      corrected_area,
      by = "window_index"
    ) %>%

    select(
      id,
      phase,
      id_phase,
      window_start,
      low,
      est,
      high,
      akde_unit,
      source_unit,
      old_low_mixed_units,
      old_est_mixed_units,
      old_high_mixed_units
    )


  migratory_fixed_parts[[length(migratory_fixed_parts) + 1]] <- corrected_group


  validation[[length(validation) + 1]] <- tibble(

    dataset = "migratory",

    group = id_phase,

    n_ud = n_ud,

    n_window_rows = n_old,

    status = "CORRECTED"
  )


  rm(
    ud_list,
    corrected_area,
    corrected_group,
    old_group
  )

  gc()
}


# =============================================================================
# COMBINE MIGRATORY RESULTS
# =============================================================================

migratory_corrected <- bind_rows(
  migratory_fixed_parts
)


# =============================================================================
# VALIDATION
# =============================================================================

validation_df <- bind_rows(
  validation
)


cat(
  "\n",
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "UNIT-REPAIR VALIDATION\n"
)

cat(
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)


print(
  validation_df %>%
    count(
      dataset,
      status
    )
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Every corrected value must explicitly be km²
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

stopifnot(
  all(
    resident_corrected$akde_unit ==
      "square_kilometers"
  )
)


stopifnot(
  all(
    migratory_corrected$akde_unit ==
      "square_kilometers"
  )
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CI ordering must remain valid
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

resident_bad_ci <- resident_corrected %>%

  filter(
    low > est |
      est > high
  )


migratory_bad_ci <- migratory_corrected %>%

  filter(
    low > est |
      est > high
  )


cat(
  "\nResident invalid CI rows:",
  nrow(resident_bad_ci),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Migratory invalid CI rows:",
  nrow(migratory_bad_ci),
  "\n"
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Summary after correction
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\nResident corrected AKDE estimate summary (km²):\n"
)


print(
  summary(
    resident_corrected$est
  )
)


cat(
  "\nMigratory corrected AKDE estimate summary (km²):\n"
)


print(
  summary(
    migratory_corrected$est
  )
)


# =============================================================================
# SAVE CORRECTED FILES
# =============================================================================

write_csv(
  resident_corrected,
  RESIDENT_CORRECTED_OUT
)


write_csv(
  migratory_corrected,
  MIGRATORY_CORRECTED_OUT
)


write_csv(
  validation_df,
  VALIDATION_OUT
)


cat(
  "\nCorrected resident fil<LOCAL_PATH>",
  RESIDENT_CORRECTED_OUT,
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "\nCorrected migratory fil<LOCAL_PATH>",
  MIGRATORY_CORRECTED_OUT,
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "\nValidation repor<LOCAL_PATH>",
  VALIDATION_OUT,
  "\n"
)

```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# CONTINUE MIGRATORY REPAIR SAFELY
#
# - Keeps groups already corrected in this R session
# - Does NOT restart completed groups
# - Catches corrupted/unreadable RDS files
# - Continues instead of crashing
# =============================================================================


# =============================================================================
# IDENTIFY GROUPS THAT HAVE ALREADY BEEN SUCCESSFULLY CORRECTED
# =============================================================================

completed_migratory_groups <- character(0)


if (
  exists("validation") &&
  length(validation) > 0
) {

  completed_migratory_groups <- unique(
    unlist(
      lapply(
        validation,
        function(x) {

          if (
            "dataset" %in% names(x) &&
            "group" %in% names(x) &&
            "status" %in% names(x) &&
            nrow(x) > 0 &&
            x$dataset[1] == "migratory" &&
            x$status[1] == "CORRECTED"
          ) {

            return(
              as.character(
                x$group[1]
              )
            )

          }

          NULL
        }
      )
    )
  )
}


cat(
  "\nAlready-corrected migratory groups:",
  length(completed_migratory_groups),
  "\n"
)


# =============================================================================
# CONTINUE THROUGH ALL FILES
#
# Previously completed groups are skipped automatically.
# =============================================================================

for (i in seq_along(migratory_files)) {

  file <- migratory_files[i]


  group_name <- basename(
    file
  ) %>%
    str_remove(
      "_UD_list\\.rds$"
    )


  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Skip already completed groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  if (
    group_name %in%
    completed_migratory_groups
  ) {

    next
  }


  cat(
    "\n[",
    i,
    "/",
    length(migratory_files),
    "] Migratory group: ",
    group_name,
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )


  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Existing window metadata
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  old_group <- migratory_old %>%

    filter(
      id_phase == group_name
    ) %>%

    arrange(
      window_start
    )


  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SAFE readRDS
  #
  # A corrupt xz file will no longer terminate the entire repair.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ud_list <- tryCatch(

    {

      readRDS(
        file
      )

    },

    error = function(e) {

      message(
        "\nRDS READ ERROR for ",
        group_name,
        ": ",
        e$message
      )

      NULL
    }
  )


  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # If unreadable, log and continue
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  if (
    is.null(ud_list)
  ) {

    validation[[length(validation) + 1]] <- tibble(

      dataset =
        "migratory",

      group =
        group_name,

      n_ud =
        NA_integer_,

      n_window_rows =
        nrow(old_group),

      status =
        "RDS_READ_ERROR"
    )


    cat(
      "Skipping corrupted/unreadable file and continuing.\n"
    )


    rm(
      old_group
    )

    gc()

    next
  }


  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Compare counts
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  n_ud <- length(
    ud_list
  )


  n_old <- nrow(
    old_group
  )


  cat(
    "Saved UDs:",
    n_ud,
    "| Existing window rows:",
    n_old,
    "\n"
  )


  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Do NOT guess if alignment is uncertain
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  if (
    n_ud != n_old
  ) {

    warning(
      paste0(
        "COUNT MISMATCH FOR MIGRATORY ",
        group_name,
        ": ",
        n_ud,
        " UDs vs ",
        n_old,
        " window rows. SKIPPING."
      )
    )


    validation[[length(validation) + 1]] <- tibble(

      dataset =
        "migratory",

      group =
        group_name,

      n_ud =
        n_ud,

      n_window_rows =
        n_old,

      status =
        "COUNT_MISMATCH"
    )


    rm(
      ud_list,
      old_group
    )

    gc()

    next
  }


  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Extract corrected AKDE values in km²
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  corrected_area <- map_dfr(

    seq_along(
      ud_list
    ),

    function(j) {

      area <- extract_akde_area_km2(
        ud_list[[j]]
      )


      area %>%

        mutate(
          window_index = j
        )
    }
  )


  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Combine with window dates
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  corrected_group <- old_group %>%

    mutate(
      window_index = row_number()
    ) %>%

    rename(

      old_low_mixed_units =
        low,

      old_est_mixed_units =
        est,

      old_high_mixed_units =
        high
    ) %>%

    select(
      id,
      phase,
      id_phase,
      window_start,
      window_index,
      old_low_mixed_units,
      old_est_mixed_units,
      old_high_mixed_units
    ) %>%

    left_join(
      corrected_area,
      by = "window_index"
    ) %>%

    select(
      id,
      phase,
      id_phase,
      window_start,
      low,
      est,
      high,
      akde_unit,
      source_unit,
      old_low_mixed_units,
      old_est_mixed_units,
      old_high_mixed_units
    )


  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Store successful result
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  migratory_fixed_parts[[length(migratory_fixed_parts) + 1]] <- corrected_group


  validation[[length(validation) + 1]] <- tibble(

    dataset =
      "migratory",

    group =
      group_name,

    n_ud =
      n_ud,

    n_window_rows =
      n_old,

    status =
      "CORRECTED"
  )


  cat(
    "Corrected successfully.\n"
  )


  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # MEMORY CLEANUP
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  rm(
    ud_list,
    corrected_area,
    corrected_group,
    old_group
  )

  gc()
}
```
