### Rebuild migr_tel_list_failed
```{r}
# =============================================================================
# REBUILD migr_tel_list_failed ONLY
#
# This does NOT run AKDE.
# This does NOT touch the 75 repaired groups.
# It only rebuilds the telemetry objects for the 10 failed phases.
# =============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
library(janitor)
library(sf)
library(tibble)
library(ctmm)


# =============================================================================
# PATHS
# =============================================================================

input_file <- paste0(
  "<LOCAL_PATH>",
  "combined_migratory_ids_cleaned_no_unrealistic_points.csv"
)

MIGRATORY_BASE <- "<LOCAL_PATH>"

VALIDATION_FILE <- file.path(
  MIGRATORY_BASE,
  "AKDE_unit_repair_validation.csv"
)


# =============================================================================
# LOAD FAILED GROUP LIST
# =============================================================================

validation_df <- read_csv(
  VALIDATION_FILE,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)


failed_groups <- validation_df %>%
  filter(
    dataset == "migratory",
    status == "RDS_READ_ERROR"
  ) %>%
  distinct(group) %>%
  pull(group)


cat(
  "\nFailed groups:",
  length(failed_groups),
  "\n"
)

print(
  failed_groups
)


# =============================================================================
# DATETIME PARSER
# =============================================================================

parse_datetime_safe <- function(x) {

  parse_date_time(
    x,
    orders = c(
      "Y-m-d H:M:S",
      "Y-m-d H:M",
      "Y-m-d",
      "ymd HMS",
      "ymd HM",
      "ymd",
      "mdy HMS",
      "mdy HM",
      "mdy"
    ),
    tz = "UTC"
  )
}


# =============================================================================
# LOAD ORIGINAL CLEAN MIGRATORY DATA
# =============================================================================

migr_data <- read_csv(
  input_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  clean_names()


cat(
  "\nRows loaded:",
  nrow(migr_data),
  "\n"
)


# =============================================================================
# STANDARDIZE DATETIME
# =============================================================================

if ("date_time" %in% names(migr_data)) {

  migr_data <- migr_data %>%
    mutate(
      date_time = parse_datetime_safe(
        date_time
      )
    )

} else if ("date" %in% names(migr_data)) {

  migr_data <- migr_data %>%
    mutate(
      date_time = parse_datetime_safe(
        date
      )
    )

} else {

  stop(
    "No date or date_time column found."
  )
}


# =============================================================================
# RECREATE ORIGINAL PHASE LABELS
# =============================================================================

migr_clean <- migr_data %>%

  mutate(

    id = as.character(
      id
    ),

    phases = as.character(
      phases
    ),

    phases_clean = phases %>%
      str_trim() %>%
      str_squish() %>%
      str_replace_all(
        "_",
        " "
      ),

    phases_clean_lower = str_to_lower(
      phases_clean
    )
  ) %>%

  filter(
    !is.na(longitude),
    !is.na(latitude),
    !is.na(date_time),
    !is.na(phases_clean),
    phases_clean_lower != "remove"
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    phase_num = str_extract(
      phases_clean_lower,
      "\\d+"
    ),

    phase_label = if_else(
      !is.na(phase_num),

      paste0(
        "Phase_",
        phase_num
      ),

      str_replace_all(
        phases_clean,
        "\\s+",
        "_"
      )
    ),

    id_phase = paste(
      id,
      phase_label,
      sep = "_"
    )
  )


# =============================================================================
# KEEP ONLY FAILED GROUPS
# =============================================================================

migr_failed <- migr_clean %>%

  filter(
    id_phase %in% failed_groups
  )


cat(
  "\nRows retained for failed groups:",
  nrow(migr_failed),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "\nFix count<LOCAL_PATH>"
)


print(
  migr_failed %>%
    count(
      id_phase,
      sort = TRUE
    ),
  n = Inf
)


# =============================================================================
# MAKE SURE ALL FAILED GROUPS ARE PRESENT
# =============================================================================

groups_found <- sort(
  unique(
    migr_failed$id_phase
  )
)


groups_missing <- setdiff(
  failed_groups,
  groups_found
)


cat(
  "\nFailed groups requested:",
  length(failed_groups),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Failed groups found:",
  length(groups_found),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Missing groups:",
  length(groups_missing),
  "\n"
)


if (length(groups_missing) > 0) {

  print(
    groups_missing
  )

  stop(
    "Some failed groups are missing from the cleaned migratory data."
  )
}


# =============================================================================
# BUILD SF OBJECT
# =============================================================================

migr_sf <- migr_failed %>%

  st_as_sf(
    coords = c(
      "longitude",
      "latitude"
    ),
    crs = 4326,
    remove = FALSE
  )


migr_ll <- migr_sf %>%

  st_coordinates() %>%

  as_tibble() %>%

  rename(
    location.long = X,
    location.lat = Y
  )


# =============================================================================
# BUILD CTMM TELEMETRY DATAFRAME
# =============================================================================

migr_dat <- migr_failed %>%

  bind_cols(
    migr_ll
  ) %>%

  select(
    individual.local.identifier = id_phase,
    location.long,
    location.lat,
    timestamp = date_time
  ) %>%

  arrange(
    individual.local.identifier,
    timestamp
  ) %>%

  distinct(
    individual.local.identifier,
    timestamp,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )


# =============================================================================
# CREATE TELEMETRY LIST
# =============================================================================

migr_tel_list_failed <- as.telemetry(
  migr_dat,
  timeformat = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
  timezone = "UTC"
)


# =============================================================================
# VALIDATE
# =============================================================================

cat(
  "\n",
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "FAILED-GROUP TELEMETRY REBUILT\n"
)

cat(
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "\nTelemetry groups:",
  length(migr_tel_list_failed),
  "\n"
)


print(
  names(
    migr_tel_list_failed
  )
)


missing_tel <- setdiff(
  failed_groups,
  names(migr_tel_list_failed)
)


cat(
  "\nMissing telemetry groups:",
  length(missing_tel),
  "\n"
)


if (length(missing_tel) > 0) {

  print(
    missing_tel
  )

} else {

  cat(
    "\nSUCCESS: all failed groups have telemetry ready for parallel AKDE recovery.\n"
  )
}

```

### Recovery
```{r}
# =============================================================================
# PARALLEL RECOVERY OF THE FAILED MIGRATORY AKDE GROUPS
#
# M2 Ultra version
#
# - 8 parallel workers by default
# - Maximum useful workers = number of failed groups
# - Self-contained workers: does NOT depend on recover_group()
# - Global window-level progress bar
# - summary(UD, units = FALSE)
# - Converts m² -> km² explicitly
# - Saves every phase immediately
# - Restart-safe
# =============================================================================

library(future)
library(furrr)
library(progressr)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tibble)
library(stringr)
library(ctmm)


# =============================================================================
# SETTINGS
# =============================================================================

MIGRATORY_BASE <- "<LOCAL_PATH>"

RECOVERY_DIR <- file.path(
  MIGRATORY_BASE,
  "recovered_corrupt_groups_km2"
)

VALIDATION_FILE <- file.path(
  MIGRATORY_BASE,
  "AKDE_unit_repair_validation.csv"
)

dir.create(
  RECOVERY_DIR,
  showWarnings = FALSE,
  recursive = TRUE
)


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# M2 Ultra:
#
# Start with 8.
#
# If memory pressure remains green, change this to 10L.
#
# More than 10 gives no benefit because we only have 10 failed groups.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

N_WORKERS <- 8L


# Progress update every N windows
PROGRESS_EVERY <- 25L


# =============================================================================
# LOAD FAILED GROUPS
# =============================================================================

validation_df <- read_csv(
  VALIDATION_FILE,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)


failed_groups <- validation_df %>%
  filter(
    dataset == "migratory",
    status == "RDS_READ_ERROR"
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    group
  ) %>%
  pull(
    group
  )


cat(
  "\nFailed groups originally identified:",
  length(failed_groups),
  "\n"
)

print(
  failed_groups
)


# =============================================================================
# REMOVE GROUPS THAT HAVE ALREADY BEEN SUCCESSFULLY RECOVERED
# =============================================================================

expected_output_files <- file.path(
  RECOVERY_DIR,
  paste0(
    failed_groups,
    "_AKDE_CORRECTED_km2.csv"
  )
)


already_complete <- (
  file.exists(expected_output_files) &
  file.info(expected_output_files)$size > 0
)


completed_groups <- failed_groups[
  already_complete
]


groups_to_run <- failed_groups[
  !already_complete
]


cat(
  "\nAlready recovered:",
  length(completed_groups),
  "\n"
)


if (length(completed_groups) > 0) {
  print(completed_groups)
}


cat(
  "\nStill requiring calculation:",
  length(groups_to_run),
  "\n"
)


if (length(groups_to_run) > 0) {
  print(groups_to_run)
}


if (length(groups_to_run) == 0) {
  stop(
    "All failed groups have already been recovered."
  )
}


# =============================================================================
# CHECK THAT TELEMETRY EXISTS
# =============================================================================

if (!exists("migr_tel_list_failed")) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "migr_tel_list_failed is not in memory.\n",
      "Rerun the recovery setup through the ",
      "as.telemetry() step first."
    )
  )
}


missing_telemetry <- groups_to_run[
  !groups_to_run %in% names(migr_tel_list_failed)
]


if (length(missing_telemetry) > 0) {

  stop(
    paste0(
      "Missing telemetry for: ",
      paste(
        missing_telemetry,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  )
}


# =============================================================================
# PASS ONLY THE REQUIRED TELEMETRY TO FUTURE WORKERS
#
# This avoids unnecessarily exporting every telemetry object.
# =============================================================================

tel_to_run <- migr_tel_list_failed[
  groups_to_run
]


# =============================================================================
# CALCULATE NUMBER OF WINDOWS FOR PROGRESS BAR
# =============================================================================

week_sec <- 7 * 24 * 3600


n_starts <- vapply(
  tel_to_run,
  function(tel) {

    sum(
      tel$t <= max(tel$t) - week_sec
    )
  },
  integer(1)
)


progress_ticks <- vapply(
  n_starts,
  function(n) {

    as.integer(
      max(
        1,
        ceiling(
          n / PROGRESS_EVERY
        )
      )
    )
  },
  integer(1)
)


TOTAL_PROGRESS_TICKS <- sum(
  progress_ticks
)


cat(
  "\nAKDE starting windows across remaining groups:",
  sum(n_starts),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Progress updates:",
  TOTAL_PROGRESS_TICKS,
  "\n"
)


# =============================================================================
# WORKER COUNT
# =============================================================================

actual_workers <- min(
  N_WORKERS,
  length(groups_to_run)
)


cat(
  "\nUsing",
  actual_workers,
  "parallel workers.\n"
)


# =============================================================================
# MULTIPROCESSING PLAN
# =============================================================================

plan(
  multisession,
  workers = actual_workers
)


# =============================================================================
# PROGRESS BAR
# =============================================================================

handlers(
  "txtprogressbar"
)


# =============================================================================
# RUN IN PARALLEL
# =============================================================================

overall_start <- Sys.time()


recovery_summary <- with_progress({

  p <- progressor(
    steps = TOTAL_PROGRESS_TICKS
  )


  future_map2_dfr(

    groups_to_run,

    tel_to_run,

    function(
      group_name,
      tel
    ) {

      # =======================================================================
      # LOCAL SETTINGS
      # =======================================================================

      group_start <- Sys.time()

      day_sec <- 24 * 3600
      week_sec <- 7 * day_sec


      output_file <- file.path(
        RECOVERY_DIR,
        paste0(
          group_name,
          "_AKDE_CORRECTED_km2.csv"
        )
      )


      # =======================================================================
      # RESTART SAFETY
      # =======================================================================

      if (
        file.exists(output_file) &&
        file.info(output_file)$size > 0
      ) {

        return(
          tibble(

            group =
              group_name,

            status =
              "ALREADY_COMPLETE",

            n_windows =
              NA_integer_,

            n_failed_windows =
              NA_integer_,

            elapsed_minutes =
              0,

            output_file =
              output_file
          )
        )
      }


      # =======================================================================
      # LOCAL AKDE AREA EXTRACTION
      #
      # IMPORTANT:
      # units = FALSE -> square meters
      #
      # Explicit conversion:
      #
      # m² / 1,000,000 = km²
      # =======================================================================

      extract_area_km2 <- function(UD) {

        ci <- summary(
          UD,
          units = FALSE
        )$CI


        if (is.null(ci)) {
          stop(
            "AKDE CI is NULL."
          )
        }


        area_idx <- grep(
          "^area",
          rownames(ci),
          ignore.case = TRUE
        )


        if (length(area_idx) != 1) {

          stop(
            paste0(
              "Expected exactly one area row; found ",
              length(area_idx)
            )
          )
        }


        unit_label <- rownames(
          ci
        )[area_idx]


        if (
          !grepl(
            "square meters",
            unit_label,
            ignore.case = TRUE
          )
        ) {

          stop(
            paste0(
              "Unexpected AKDE unit: ",
              unit_label
            )
          )
        }


        tibble(

          low =
            as.numeric(
              ci[
                area_idx,
                "low"
              ]
            ) / 1e6,

          est =
            as.numeric(
              ci[
                area_idx,
                "est"
              ]
            ) / 1e6,

          high =
            as.numeric(
              ci[
                area_idx,
                "high"
              ]
            ) / 1e6,

          source_unit =
            unit_label,

          akde_unit =
            "square_kilometers"
        )
      }


      # =======================================================================
      # SLIDING-WINDOW STARTS
      # =======================================================================

      starts <- tel$t[
        tel$t <= max(tel$t) - week_sec
      ]


      if (length(starts) == 0) {

        return(
          tibble(

            group =
              group_name,

            status =
              "NO_FULL_WINDOWS",

            n_windows =
              0L,

            n_failed_windows =
              0L,

            elapsed_minutes =
              as.numeric(
                difftime(
                  Sys.time(),
                  group_start,
                  units = "mins"
                )
              ),

            output_file =
              output_file
          )
        )
      }


      # =======================================================================
      # OUTPUT STORAGE
      # =======================================================================

      output <- vector(
        "list",
        length(starts)
      )


      success_n <- 0L

      failure_n <- 0L


      # =======================================================================
      # PROCESS WINDOWS SEQUENTIALLY WITHIN THIS PHASE
      #
      # Parallelism occurs ACROSS phases.
      # =======================================================================

      for (j in seq_along(starts)) {

        t0 <- starts[j]


        win <- tel[
          tel$t >= t0 &
          tel$t <= (
            t0 + week_sec
          ),
        ]


        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Same criterion as original AKDE analysis
        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

        if (
          length(win$t) >= 20
        ) {

          result <- tryCatch(

            {

              v0 <- variogram(
                win,
                CI = "Gauss"
              )


              v2 <- variogram.fit(
                v0,
                name = "GuessBM",
                interactive = FALSE
              )


              m0 <- ctmm.select(
                win,
                v2,
                IC = "BIC"
              )


              UD <- akde(
                win,
                m0,
                weights = TRUE
              )


              area <- extract_area_km2(
                UD
              )


              area %>%
                mutate(

                  window_start =
                    as.POSIXct(
                      t0,
                      origin = "1970-01-01",
                      tz = "UTC"
                    ),

                  n_fixes_window =
                    length(win$t)
                )

            },

            error = function(e) {

              NULL
            }
          )


          if (!is.null(result)) {

            success_n <- success_n + 1L


            output[[success_n]] <- result

          } else {

            failure_n <- failure_n + 1L
          }
        }


        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        # GLOBAL PROGRESS UPDATE
        #
        # Signal every 25 windows instead of every window.
        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

        if (
          j %% PROGRESS_EVERY == 0 ||
          j == length(starts)
        ) {

          p(
            message = paste0(
              group_name,
              ": ",
              j,
              "/",
              length(starts)
            )
          )
        }
      }


      # =======================================================================
      # COMBINE SUCCESSFUL WINDOWS
      # =======================================================================

      if (success_n > 0) {

        area_df <- bind_rows(
          output[
            seq_len(
              success_n
            )
          ]
        )

      } else {

        area_df <- tibble()
      }


      # =======================================================================
      # ID / PHASE
      # =======================================================================

      deer_id <- str_extract(
        group_name,
        "^[^_]+"
      )


      phase_name <- str_remove(
        group_name,
        paste0(
          "^",
          deer_id,
          "_"
        )
      )


      if (nrow(area_df) > 0) {

        area_df <- area_df %>%

          mutate(

            id =
              deer_id,

            phase =
              phase_name,

            id_phase =
              group_name
          ) %>%

          select(
            id,
            phase,
            id_phase,
            window_start,
            n_fixes_window,
            low,
            est,
            high,
            source_unit,
            akde_unit
          )
      }


      # =======================================================================
      # SAVE PHASE IMMEDIATELY
      # =======================================================================

      write_csv(
        area_df,
        output_file
      )


      # =======================================================================
      # RETURN COMPACT STATUS ONLY
      # =======================================================================

      elapsed <- as.numeric(
        difftime(
          Sys.time(),
          group_start,
          units = "mins"
        )
      )


      tibble(

        group =
          group_name,

        status =
          "RECOVERED",

        n_windows =
          nrow(area_df),

        n_failed_windows =
          failure_n,

        elapsed_minutes =
          elapsed,

        output_file =
          output_file
      )
    },


    # =========================================================================
    # EXPLICITLY LOAD PACKAGES ON WORKERS
    #
    # globals = TRUE ensures objects such as RECOVERY_DIR,
    # PROGRESS_EVERY and p are exported.
    # =========================================================================

    .options = furrr_options(

      seed = TRUE,

      globals = TRUE,

      packages = c(
        "ctmm",
        "dplyr",
        "readr",
        "tibble",
        "stringr"
      )
    )
  )
})


# =============================================================================
# RETURN TO NORMAL R EXECUTION
# =============================================================================

plan(
  sequential
)


# =============================================================================
# REPORT
# =============================================================================

total_elapsed <- as.numeric(
  difftime(
    Sys.time(),
    overall_start,
    units = "mins"
  )
)


cat(
  "\n",
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "PARALLEL AKDE RECOVERY COMPLETE\n"
)

cat(
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "\nTotal elapsed time:",
  round(
    total_elapsed,
    2
  ),
  "minutes\n"
)


print(
  recovery_summary,
  n = Inf
)


# =============================================================================
# SAVE LOG
# =============================================================================

write_csv(

  recovery_summary,

  file.path(
    MIGRATORY_BASE,
    "AKDE_parallel_recovery_log.csv"
  )
)
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# POST-AKDE RECOVERY:
# VALIDATE + COMBINE ALL CORRECTED MIGRATORY AKDE RESULTS
#
# Run this AFTER the parallel recovery reaches 100%.
#
# This script:
#
#   1. Loads the 75 groups repaired from readable RDS files.
#   2. Loads the 10 groups recalculated from telemetry.
#   3. Confirms all expected recovery files exist.
#   4. Checks recovered window_start values against the original AKDE table.
#   5. Checks units.
#   6. Checks low <= est <= high.
#   7. Checks for NA / non-finite / non-positive AKDE values.
#   8. Checks duplicate ID-phase/window combinations.
#   9. Confirms all 85 migratory groups are represented.
#  10. Saves ONE final corrected migratory AKDE table.
#
# IMPORTANT:
# It will STOP instead of saving if a major validation fails.
# =============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)
library(lubridate)


# =============================================================================
# PATHS
# =============================================================================

MIGRATORY_BASE <- "<LOCAL_PATH>"


GOOD_GROUPS_FILE <- file.path(
  MIGRATORY_BASE,
  "migratory_AKDE_7day_windows_CORRECTED_km2_GOOD_GROUPS.csv"
)


RECOVERY_DIR <- file.path(
  MIGRATORY_BASE,
  "recovered_corrupt_groups_km2"
)


ORIGINAL_WINDOWS_FILE <- file.path(
  MIGRATORY_BASE,
  "migratory_AKDE_7day_windows.csv"
)


VALIDATION_FILE <- file.path(
  MIGRATORY_BASE,
  "AKDE_unit_repair_validation.csv"
)


RECOVERY_LOG_FILE <- file.path(
  MIGRATORY_BASE,
  "AKDE_parallel_recovery_log.csv"
)


FINAL_OUT <- file.path(
  MIGRATORY_BASE,
  "migratory_AKDE_7day_windows_CORRECTED_km2_FINAL.csv"
)


FINAL_VALIDATION_OUT <- file.path(
  MIGRATORY_BASE,
  "migratory_AKDE_FINAL_validation_report.csv"
)


# =============================================================================
# HELPER: NORMALIZE DATETIME
# =============================================================================

normalize_datetime <- function(x) {

  if (inherits(x, "POSIXct")) {

    return(
      as.POSIXct(
        x,
        tz = "UTC"
      )
    )
  }


  as.POSIXct(
    x,
    tz = "UTC"
  )
}


# =============================================================================
# VERIFY REQUIRED FILES / DIRECTORIES
# =============================================================================

required_files <- c(
  GOOD_GROUPS_FILE,
  ORIGINAL_WINDOWS_FILE,
  VALIDATION_FILE
)


missing_required <- required_files[
  !file.exists(required_files)
]


if (length(missing_required) > 0) {

  cat(
    "\nMissing required file<LOCAL_PATH>"
  )

  print(
    missing_required
  )

  stop(
    "Required files are missing."
  )
}


if (!dir.exists(RECOVERY_DIR)) {

  stop(
    paste(
      "Recovery directory does not exist:",
      RECOVERY_DIR
    )
  )
}


# =============================================================================
# LOAD ORIGINAL VALIDATION INFORMATION
# =============================================================================

validation_df <- read_csv(
  VALIDATION_FILE,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)


failed_groups <- validation_df %>%

  filter(
    dataset == "migratory",
    status == "RDS_READ_ERROR"
  ) %>%

  distinct(
    group
  ) %>%

  pull(
    group
  )


cat(
  "\n",
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n",
  "FAILED GROUPS EXPECTED TO HAVE BEEN RECALCULATED\n",
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


cat(
  "\nNumber:",
  length(failed_groups),
  "\n"
)


print(
  failed_groups
)


if (length(failed_groups) != 10) {

  warning(
    paste(
      "Expected 10 failed groups but validation file contains",
      length(failed_groups)
    )
  )
}


# =============================================================================
# CHECK PARALLEL RECOVERY LOG
# =============================================================================

if (file.exists(RECOVERY_LOG_FILE)) {

  recovery_log <- read_csv(
    RECOVERY_LOG_FILE,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )


  cat(
    "\n",
    paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
    "\n",
    "PARALLEL RECOVERY LOG\n",
    paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )


  print(
    recovery_log,
    n = Inf
  )


  failed_runs <- recovery_log %>%

    filter(
      !status %in% c(
        "RECOVERED",
        "ALREADY_COMPLETE"
      )
    )


  if (nrow(failed_runs) > 0) {

    cat(
      "\nRECOVERY FAILURES DETECTE<LOCAL_PATH>"
    )

    print(
      failed_runs,
      n = Inf
    )

    stop(
      "At least one AKDE recovery phase failed."
    )
  }

} else {

  warning(
    "Parallel recovery log was not found. Continuing using recovered CSVs."
  )
}


# =============================================================================
# FIND RECOVERED CSV FILES
# =============================================================================

recovered_files <- list.files(
  RECOVERY_DIR,
  pattern = "_AKDE_CORRECTED_km2\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)


cat(
  "\n",
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n",
  "RECOVERED FILES\n",
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


cat(
  "\nRecovered files found:",
  length(recovered_files),
  "\n"
)


print(
  basename(
    recovered_files
  )
)


# =============================================================================
# DETERMINE GROUP NAME FROM EACH FILE
# =============================================================================

recovered_file_groups <- basename(
  recovered_files
) %>%

  str_remove(
    "_AKDE_CORRECTED_km2\\.csv$"
  )


missing_recovery_files <- setdiff(
  failed_groups,
  recovered_file_groups
)


unexpected_recovery_files <- setdiff(
  recovered_file_groups,
  failed_groups
)


cat(
  "\nMissing expected recovery files:",
  length(missing_recovery_files),
  "\n"
)


if (length(missing_recovery_files) > 0) {

  print(
    missing_recovery_files
  )
}


cat(
  "Unexpected recovery files:",
  length(unexpected_recovery_files),
  "\n"
)


if (length(unexpected_recovery_files) > 0) {

  print(
    unexpected_recovery_files
  )
}


if (
  length(missing_recovery_files) > 0 ||
  length(unexpected_recovery_files) > 0
) {

  stop(
    "Recovery-file set does not match expected failed groups."
  )
}


# =============================================================================
# LOAD 75 REPAIRED GROUPS
# =============================================================================

good <- read_csv(
  GOOD_GROUPS_FILE,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)


good <- good %>%

  mutate(
    window_start =
      normalize_datetime(
        window_start
      )
  )


cat(
  "\n",
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n",
  "READABLE-RDS GROUPS\n",
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


cat(
  "\nRows:",
  nrow(good),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Groups:",
  n_distinct(good$id_phase),
  "\n"
)


# =============================================================================
# LOAD 10 RECALCULATED GROUPS
# =============================================================================

recovered <- map_dfr(

  recovered_files,

  function(file) {

    x <- read_csv(
      file,
      show_col_types = FALSE
    )


    expected_group <- basename(
      file
    ) %>%

      str_remove(
        "_AKDE_CORRECTED_km2\\.csv$"
      )


    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # File should contain exactly one group
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    groups_inside <- unique(
      x$id_phase
    )


    if (
      length(groups_inside) != 1 ||
      groups_inside != expected_group
    ) {

      stop(
        paste(
          "Group/file mismatch in:",
          basename(file)
        )
      )
    }


    x %>%

      mutate(
        window_start =
          normalize_datetime(
            window_start
          )
      )
  }
)


cat(
  "\n",
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n",
  "RECALCULATED GROUPS\n",
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


cat(
  "\nRows:",
  nrow(recovered),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Groups:",
  n_distinct(recovered$id_phase),
  "\n"
)


print(
  sort(
    unique(
      recovered$id_phase
    )
  )
)


# =============================================================================
# LOAD ORIGINAL AKDE WINDOWS
#
# We use this ONLY to verify the window structure.
#
# We DO NOT trust its low/est/high values because those are the mixed-unit
# values we are repairing.
# =============================================================================

original <- read_csv(
  ORIGINAL_WINDOWS_FILE,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)


original <- original %>%

  mutate(
    window_start =
      normalize_datetime(
        window_start
      )
  )


# =============================================================================
# CHECK RECALCULATED WINDOW KEYS AGAINST ORIGINAL
# =============================================================================

original_failed_keys <- original %>%

  filter(
    id_phase %in% failed_groups
  ) %>%

  distinct(
    id_phase,
    window_start
  )


recovered_keys <- recovered %>%

  distinct(
    id_phase,
    window_start
  )


missing_recovered_windows <- anti_join(
  original_failed_keys,
  recovered_keys,
  by = c(
    "id_phase",
    "window_start"
  )
)


extra_recovered_windows <- anti_join(
  recovered_keys,
  original_failed_keys,
  by = c(
    "id_phase",
    "window_start"
  )
)


cat(
  "\n",
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n",
  "RECOVERED WINDOW ALIGNMENT\n",
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


cat(
  "\nOriginal windows for failed groups:",
  nrow(original_failed_keys),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Recovered windows:",
  nrow(recovered_keys),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Original windows missing from recovery:",
  nrow(missing_recovered_windows),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "New/unexpected recovered windows:",
  nrow(extra_recovered_windows),
  "\n"
)


# =============================================================================
# SHOW COUNTS BY GROUP
# =============================================================================

original_counts <- original_failed_keys %>%

  count(
    id_phase,
    name = "original_windows"
  )


recovered_counts <- recovered_keys %>%

  count(
    id_phase,
    name = "recovered_windows"
  )


window_count_check <- full_join(
  original_counts,
  recovered_counts,
  by = "id_phase"
) %>%

  mutate(
    difference =
      recovered_windows -
      original_windows
  ) %>%

  arrange(
    id_phase
  )


cat(
  "\nWindow counts by recalculated grou<LOCAL_PATH>"
)


print(
  window_count_check,
  n = Inf
)


# =============================================================================
# IMPORTANT:
#
# Do not automatically fail yet if there are a tiny number of differences.
#
# A previously failed model window could conceivably succeed during the
# recalculation. But we absolutely want to inspect any mismatch before using it.
# =============================================================================

if (
  nrow(missing_recovered_windows) > 0 ||
  nrow(extra_recovered_windows) > 0
) {

  cat(
    "\nWARNING: recovered window structure differs from original.\n"
  )

  cat(
    "Do NOT continue to the autoencoder until we inspect this.\n"
  )


  write_csv(
    missing_recovered_windows,
    file.path(
      MIGRATORY_BASE,
      "AKDE_recovery_missing_windows.csv"
    )
  )


  write_csv(
    extra_recovered_windows,
    file.path(
      MIGRATORY_BASE,
      "AKDE_recovery_extra_windows.csv"
    )
  )


  write_csv(
    window_count_check,
    file.path(
      MIGRATORY_BASE,
      "AKDE_recovery_window_count_check.csv"
    )
  )


  stop(
    "Recovered AKDE window structure does not exactly match the original."
  )
}


# =============================================================================
# COMBINE ALL 85 GROUPS
# =============================================================================

final <- bind_rows(
  good,
  recovered
) %>%

  arrange(
    id_phase,
    window_start
  )


# =============================================================================
# GROUP COVERAGE
# =============================================================================

expected_groups <- sort(
  unique(
    original$id_phase
  )
)


final_groups <- sort(
  unique(
    final$id_phase
  )
)


missing_groups <- setdiff(
  expected_groups,
  final_groups
)


unexpected_groups <- setdiff(
  final_groups,
  expected_groups
)


cat(
  "\n",
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n",
  "FINAL GROUP COVERAGE\n",
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


cat(
  "\nExpected groups:",
  length(expected_groups),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Final groups:",
  length(final_groups),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Missing groups:",
  length(missing_groups),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Unexpected groups:",
  length(unexpected_groups),
  "\n"
)


if (length(missing_groups) > 0) {

  print(
    missing_groups
  )
}


if (length(unexpected_groups) > 0) {

  print(
    unexpected_groups
  )
}


# =============================================================================
# DUPLICATE WINDOW CHECK
# =============================================================================

duplicate_windows <- final %>%

  count(
    id_phase,
    window_start,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%

  filter(
    n > 1
  )


cat(
  "\nDuplicate ID-phase/window combinations:",
  nrow(duplicate_windows),
  "\n"
)


# =============================================================================
# UNIT CHECK
# =============================================================================

unit_summary <- final %>%

  count(
    akde_unit,
    source_unit,
    name = "n"
  )


cat(
  "\nUnit combination<LOCAL_PATH>"
)


print(
  unit_summary,
  n = Inf
)


bad_units <- final %>%

  filter(
    is.na(akde_unit) |
    akde_unit != "square_kilometers"
  )


cat(
  "\nRows not explicitly marked square_kilometers:",
  nrow(bad_units),
  "\n"
)


# =============================================================================
# NUMERIC VALIDITY
# =============================================================================

bad_numeric <- final %>%

  filter(
    is.na(low) |
    is.na(est) |
    is.na(high) |
    !is.finite(low) |
    !is.finite(est) |
    !is.finite(high)
  )


cat(
  "Rows with NA/non-finite AKDE values:",
  nrow(bad_numeric),
  "\n"
)


# =============================================================================
# POSITIVE AREA CHECK
# =============================================================================

nonpositive <- final %>%

  filter(
    low <= 0 |
    est <= 0 |
    high <= 0
  )


cat(
  "Rows with non-positive AKDE values:",
  nrow(nonpositive),
  "\n"
)


# =============================================================================
# CI ORDER CHECK
# =============================================================================

bad_ci <- final %>%

  filter(
    low > est |
    est > high
  )


cat(
  "Rows with invalid low <= est <= high ordering:",
  nrow(bad_ci),
  "\n"
)


# =============================================================================
# CHECK THE OLD MIXED-UNIT VALUES AGAINST CORRECTED VALUES
#
# For the 75 readable-RDS groups, this is a useful forensic check.
#
# Depending on what summary(..., units=TRUE) selected, ratios should generally
# correspond to unit conversions rather than arbitrary numeric changes.
# =============================================================================

if (
  all(
    c(
      "old_est_mixed_units",
      "est"
    ) %in% names(final)
  )
) {

  ratio_check <- final %>%

    filter(
      !is.na(old_est_mixed_units),
      !is.na(est),
      est > 0
    ) %>%

    mutate(
      old_to_corrected_ratio =
        old_est_mixed_units / est
    )


  cat(
    "\nOld mixed-unit / corrected km² ratio summar<LOCAL_PATH>"
  )


  print(
    summary(
      ratio_check$old_to_corrected_ratio
    )
  )
}


# =============================================================================
# BUILD VALIDATION SUMMARY
# =============================================================================

validation_report <- tibble(

  check = c(
    "expected_groups",
    "final_groups",
    "missing_groups",
    "unexpected_groups",
    "duplicate_windows",
    "bad_units",
    "bad_numeric",
    "nonpositive_values",
    "invalid_ci_order",
    "recovered_missing_windows",
    "recovered_extra_windows"
  ),

  value = c(
    length(expected_groups),
    length(final_groups),
    length(missing_groups),
    length(unexpected_groups),
    nrow(duplicate_windows),
    nrow(bad_units),
    nrow(bad_numeric),
    nrow(nonpositive),
    nrow(bad_ci),
    nrow(missing_recovered_windows),
    nrow(extra_recovered_windows)
  )
)


cat(
  "\n",
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n",
  "FINAL VALIDATION SUMMARY\n",
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


print(
  validation_report,
  n = Inf
)


write_csv(
  validation_report,
  FINAL_VALIDATION_OUT
)


# =============================================================================
# HARD PASS / FAIL
# =============================================================================

validation_pass <- (

  length(missing_groups) == 0 &&

  length(unexpected_groups) == 0 &&

  nrow(duplicate_windows) == 0 &&

  nrow(bad_units) == 0 &&

  nrow(bad_numeric) == 0 &&

  nrow(nonpositive) == 0 &&

  nrow(bad_ci) == 0 &&

  nrow(missing_recovered_windows) == 0 &&

  nrow(extra_recovered_windows) == 0
)


# =============================================================================
# SAVE FINAL FILE ONLY IF EVERYTHING PASSES
# =============================================================================

if (validation_pass) {

  write_csv(
    final,
    FINAL_OUT
  )


  cat(
    "\n",
    paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
    "\n",
    "SUCCESS: MIGRATORY AKDE VALIDATION PASSED\n",
    paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )


  cat(
    "\nFinal corrected fil<LOCAL_PATH>",
    FINAL_OUT,
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )


  cat(
    "\nTotal rows:",
    nrow(final),
    "\n"
  )


  cat(
    "Total groups:",
    n_distinct(final$id_phase),
    "\n"
  )


  cat(
    "\nAll AKDE areas are standardized to square kilometers.\n"
  )

} else {

  cat(
    "\n",
    paste(rep("!", 100), collapse = ""),
    "\n",
    "VALIDATION FAILED — FINAL FILE WAS NOT SAVED\n",
    paste(rep("!", 100), collapse = ""),
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )


  stop(
    "Inspect the validation output before proceeding."
  )
}

```

## Okay so I had to change computers and I do not have nay of the variables before. Just create the variables that we will need so that we complete the AKDE on F99 Phase_1 and Phase_2.

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# FINAL F99 AKDE RECOVERY — STANDALONE / SEQUENTIAL / RESTART-SAFE
#
# Purpose:
#
#   Recalculate ONLY:
#
#       F99_Phase_1
#       F99_Phase_2
#
#   using the exact window_start values that already existed in the
#   original migratory AKDE results.
#
# Important:
#
#   - NO multiprocessing
#   - NO previous R variables required
#   - summary(UD, units = FALSE) -> square meters
#   - converts square meters -> square kilometers
#   - checkpoints results while running
#   - can be restarted safely
# =============================================================================


# =============================================================================
# 1. PACKAGES
# =============================================================================

library(ctmm)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
library(janitor)
library(tibble)


# =============================================================================
# 2. PATHS
# =============================================================================

MIGRATORY_BASE <- "<LOCAL_PATH>"


ORIGINAL_WINDOWS_FILE <- file.path(
  MIGRATORY_BASE,

# =============================================================================
# 4. DATETIME PARSER
# =============================================================================

parse_datetime_safe <- function(x) {

  parse_date_time(
    x,
    orders = c(
      "Y-m-d H:M:S",
      "Y-m-d H:M",
      "Y-m-d",
      "ymd HMS",
      "ymd HM",
      "ymd",
      "mdy HMS",
      "mdy HM",
      "mdy"
    ),
    tz = "UTC"
  )
}


# =============================================================================
# 5. LOAD ORIGINAL AKDE WINDOW TABLE
#
# We use this ONLY to recover the exact window_start values.
#
# We do NOT trust the old low / est / high values because those contain
# the mixed-unit problem.
# =============================================================================

original <- read_csv(
  ORIGINAL_WINDOWS_FILE,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)


if (!all(
  c(
    "id_phase",
    "window_start"

)) {

    "Original AKDE file is missing id_phase or window_start."

print(

)


cat(

)


# We already know there should be 306 + 956 = 1,262.
if (nrow(f99_expected) != 1262) {

# =============================================================================
# 6. LOAD ORIGINAL CLEAN MIGRATORY TELEMETRY

# 7. IDENTIFY / PARSE DATETIME COLUMN

    )

} else if ("date" %in% names(migr_data)) {

} else {

# =============================================================================
# 8. RECREATE ORIGINAL PHASE LABELS

migr_f99 <- migr_data %>%

  mutate(

    id =
      as.character(
        id
      ),

    phases =
      as.character(
        phases
      ),

    phases_clean =
      phases %>%
      str_trim() %>%
      str_squish() %>%
      str_replace_all(

    phase_num =

    phase_label =
      if_else(

        paste0(
          "Phase_",

        ),

        str_replace_all(
          phases_clean,
          "\\s+",
          "_"
        )
      ),

    id_phase =
      paste(
        id,
        phase_label,
        sep = "_"
      )
  ) %>%

  filter(
    !is.na(longitude),
    !is.na(latitude),
    !is.na(date_time),
    !is.na(phases_clean),
    phases_clean_lower != "remove",
    id_phase %in% GROUPS_TO_RUN
  )


# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================

migr_dat <- migr_f99 %>%

# =============================================================================
# 11. PREFLIGHT:
# VERIFY EVERY ORIGINAL WINDOW START MATCHES AN ACTUAL TELEMETRY FIX
# =============================================================================

preflight <- f99_expected %>%

  rowwise() %>%

  mutate(

    nearest_fix_difference_seconds = {

      tel <- tel_list[[id_phase]]

max_difference <- max(

# =============================================================================
# 12. FIXED-UNIT AKDE EXTRACTION
#
# Critical fix:
#
# summary(..., units = FALSE)
#
# gives square meters.
#
# Divide by 1,000,000:
#
# m² -> km²
# =============================================================================

extract_akde_area_km2 <- function(UD) {

  ci <- summary(
    UD,
    units = FALSE
  )$CI


  if (is.null(ci)) {

    stop(
      "AKDE CI is NULL."
    )
  }


  area_idx <- grep(
    "^area",
    rownames(ci),
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )


  if (length(area_idx) != 1) {

    stop(
      paste0(
        "Expected exactly one area row; found ",
        length(area_idx)
      )
    )
  }


  source_unit <- rownames(
    ci
  )[area_idx]


  if (
    !grepl(
      "square meters",
      source_unit,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
  ) {

    stop(
      paste0(
        "Unexpected AKDE source unit: ",
        source_unit
      )
    )
  }


  tibble(

    low =
      as.numeric(
        ci[
          area_idx,
          "low"
        ]
      ) / 1e6,

    est =
      as.numeric(
        ci[
          area_idx,
          "est"
        ]
      ) / 1e6,

    high =
      as.numeric(
        ci[
          area_idx,
          "high"
        ]
      ) / 1e6,

    source_unit =
      source_unit,

    akde_unit =
      "square_kilometers"
  )
}


# =============================================================================
# 13. FIT ONE WINDOW
# =============================================================================

fit_one_window <- function(
  group_name,
  window_start
) {

  tel <- tel_list[[group_name]]


  week_sec <- 7 * 24 * 3600


  t0 <- as.numeric(
    window_start
  )


  win <- tel[
    tel$t >= t0 &
      tel$t <= (
        t0 + week_sec
      ),
  ]


  n_fixes <- length(
    win$t
  )


  if (n_fixes < 20) {

    stop(
      paste0(
        "Only ",
        n_fixes,
        " fixes in this window."
      )
    )
  }


  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Same model-fitting workflow used previously
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  v0 <- variogram(
    win,
    CI = "Gauss"
  )


  v2 <- variogram.fit(
    v0,
    name = "GuessBM",
    interactive = FALSE
  )


  m0 <- ctmm.select(
    win,
    v2,
    IC = "BIC"
  )


  UD <- akde(
    win,
    m0,
    weights = TRUE
  )


  area <- extract_akde_area_km2(
    UD
  )


  area %>%

    mutate(

      id =
        "F99",

      phase =
        str_remove(
          group_name,
          "^F99_"
        ),

      id_phase =
        group_name,

      window_start =
        as.POSIXct(
          t0,
          origin = "1970-01-01",
          tz = "UTC"
        ),

      n_fixes_window =
        n_fixes
    ) %>%

    select(
      id,
      phase,
      id_phase,
      window_start,
      n_fixes_window,
      low,
      est,
      high,
      source_unit,
      akde_unit
    )
}


# =============================================================================
# 14. PROCESS ONE PHASE SEQUENTIALLY
#
# Restart-safe.
# =============================================================================

recover_phase <- function(group_name) {

  cat(
    "\n",
    paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
    "\n",
    "PROCESSING ",
    group_name,
    "\n",
    paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )


  expected <- f99_expected %>%

    filter(
      id_phase == group_name
    ) %>%

    arrange(
      window_start
    )


  checkpoint_file <- file.path(
    OUTPUT_DIR,
    paste0(
      group_name,
      "_AKDE_CHECKPOINT.csv"
    )
  )


  final_file <- file.path(
    OUTPUT_DIR,
    paste0(
      group_name,
      "_AKDE_CORRECTED_km2.csv"
    )
  )


  failure_file <- file.path(
    OUTPUT_DIR,
    paste0(
      group_name,
      "_FAILED_WINDOWS.csv"
    )
  )


  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # If final file already exists, skip entirely
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  if (
    file.exists(final_file) &&
    file.info(final_file)$size > 0
  ) {

    completed <- read_csv(
      final_file,
      show_col_types = FALSE
    )


    if (nrow(completed) == nrow(expected)) {

      cat(
        "\nFinal validated-looking file already exists.",
        "Skipping ",
        group_name,
        ".\n",
        sep = ""
      )


      return(
        completed
      )
    }
  }


  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Load checkpoint if one exists
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  if (
    file.exists(checkpoint_file) &&
    file.info(checkpoint_file)$size > 0
  ) {

    results <- read_csv(
      checkpoint_file,
      show_col_types = FALSE
    )


    results <- results %>%

      mutate(
        window_start =
          parse_datetime_safe(
            window_start
          )
      )


    cat(
      "\nCheckpoint found:",
      nrow(results),
      "windows already completed.\n"
    )

  } else {

    results <- tibble()
  }


  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Determine already-completed windows
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  if (nrow(results) > 0) {

    completed_times <- as.numeric(
      results$window_start
    )

  } else {

    completed_times <- numeric(0)
  }


  jobs <- expected %>%

    filter(
      !as.numeric(window_start) %in%
        completed_times
    )


  cat(
    "\nExpected windows:",
    nrow(expected),
    "\n"
  )


  cat(
    "Already complete:",
    nrow(results),
    "\n"
  )


  cat(
    "Remaining:",
    nrow(jobs),
    "\n"
  )


  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Failure storage
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  failures <- list()


  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Timing
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  phase_start <- Sys.time()

  successful_since_checkpoint <- 0L


  # ===========================================================================
  # SEQUENTIAL LOOP
  # ===========================================================================

  for (j in seq_len(nrow(jobs))) {

    group_window_start <- jobs$window_start[j]


    result <- tryCatch(

      {

        fit_one_window(
          group_name,
          group_window_start
        )

      },

      error = function(e) {

        failures[[length(failures) + 1]] <<- tibble(

          id_phase =
            group_name,

          window_start =
            group_window_start,

          error =
            e$message
        )


        NULL
      }
    )


    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Successful fit
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    if (!is.null(result)) {

      results <- bind_rows(
        results,
        result
      )


      successful_since_checkpoint <-
        successful_since_checkpoint + 1L
    }


    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # CHECKPOINT
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    if (
      successful_since_checkpoint >=
      CHECKPOINT_EVERY
    ) {

      results <- results %>%

        arrange(
          window_start
        ) %>%

        distinct(
          id_phase,
          window_start,
          .keep_all = TRUE
        )


      write_csv(
        results,
        checkpoint_file
      )


      successful_since_checkpoint <- 0L
    }


    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # PROGRESS + ETA
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    if (
      j %% 10 == 0 ||
      j == nrow(jobs)
    ) {

      elapsed_seconds <- as.numeric(
        difftime(
          Sys.time(),
          phase_start,
          units = "secs"
        )
      )


      seconds_per_job <- (
        elapsed_seconds /
        j
      )


      remaining_jobs <- (
        nrow(jobs) -
        j
      )


      eta_minutes <- (
        remaining_jobs *
        seconds_per_job
      ) / 60


      total_done <- nrow(results)


      cat(
        "\r",
        group_name,
        " | completed: ",
        total_done,
        "/",
        nrow(expected),
        " | current run: ",
        j,
        "/",
        nrow(jobs),
        " | ETA: ",
        round(
          eta_minutes,
          1
        ),
        " min    ",
        sep = ""
      )


      flush.console()
    }
  }


  cat(
    "\n"
  )


  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SAVE FINAL CHECKPOINT
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  results <- results %>%

    arrange(
      window_start
    ) %>%

    distinct(
      id_phase,
      window_start,
      .keep_all = TRUE
    )


  write_csv(
    results,
    checkpoint_file
  )


  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SAVE FAILURES
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  if (length(failures) > 0) {

    failure_df <- bind_rows(
      failures
    )


    write_csv(
      failure_df,
      failure_file
    )


    cat(
      "\nFailed windows:",
      nrow(failure_df),
      "\n"
    )

  } else {

    cat(
      "\nFailed windows: 0\n"
    )
  }


  # ===========================================================================
  # VALIDATE THIS PHASE
  # ===========================================================================

  expected_keys <- expected %>%

    select(
      id_phase,
      window_start
    )


  result_keys <- results %>%

    select(
      id_phase,
      window_start
    )


  missing_windows <- anti_join(
    expected_keys,
    result_keys,
    by = c(
      "id_phase",
      "window_start"
    )
  )


  extra_windows <- anti_join(
    result_keys,
    expected_keys,
    by = c(
      "id_phase",
      "window_start"
    )
  )


  bad_units <- results %>%

    filter(
      is.na(akde_unit) |
        akde_unit != "square_kilometers"
    )


  bad_ci <- results %>%

    filter(
      low > est |
        est > high
    )


  bad_numeric <- results %>%

    filter(
      is.na(low) |
        is.na(est) |
        is.na(high) |
        !is.finite(low) |
        !is.finite(est) |
        !is.finite(high)
    )


  nonpositive <- results %>%

    filter(
      low <= 0 |
        est <= 0 |
        high <= 0
    )


  cat(
    "\n",
    paste(rep("-", 80), collapse = ""),
    "\n",
    "VALIDATION: ",
    group_name,
    "\n",
    paste(rep("-", 80), collapse = ""),
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )


  cat(
    "Expected:",
    nrow(expected),
    "\n"
  )


  cat(
    "Recovered:",
    nrow(results),
    "\n"
  )


  cat(
    "Missing windows:",
    nrow(missing_windows),
    "\n"
  )


  cat(
    "Extra windows:",
    nrow(extra_windows),
    "\n"
  )


  cat(
    "Bad units:",
    nrow(bad_units),
    "\n"
  )


  cat(
    "Bad numeric:",
    nrow(bad_numeric),
    "\n"
  )


  cat(
    "Non-positive:",
    nrow(nonpositive),
    "\n"
  )


  cat(
    "Bad CI ordering:",
    nrow(bad_ci),
    "\n"
  )


  phase_pass <- (

    nrow(results) ==
      nrow(expected) &&

    nrow(missing_windows) == 0 &&

    nrow(extra_windows) == 0 &&

    nrow(bad_units) == 0 &&

    nrow(bad_numeric) == 0 &&

    nrow(nonpositive) == 0 &&

    nrow(bad_ci) == 0
  )


  if (phase_pass) {

    write_csv(
      results,
      final_file
    )


    cat(
      "\nSUCCESS:",
      group_name,
      "passed validation.\n"
    )


    cat(
      "Saved:",
      final_file,
      "\n"
    )

  } else {

    cat(
      "\nWARNING:",
      group_name,
      "did NOT completely pass validation.\n"
    )


    cat(
      "Checkpoint was retained so you can resume.\n"
    )
  }


  results
}


# =============================================================================
# 15. RUN PHASE 1, THEN PHASE 2
# =============================================================================

phase1_results <- recover_phase(
  "F99_Phase_1"
)


phase2_results <- recover_phase(
  "F99_Phase_2"
)


# =============================================================================
# 16. FINAL F99 VALIDATION
# =============================================================================

f99_final <- bind_rows(
  phase1_results,
  phase2_results
) %>%

  arrange(
    id_phase,
    window_start
  )


expected_keys <- f99_expected %>%

  select(
    id_phase,
    window_start
  )


final_keys <- f99_final %>%

  select(
    id_phase,
    window_start
  ) %>%

  distinct()


missing_final <- anti_join(
  expected_keys,
  final_keys,
  by = c(
    "id_phase",
    "window_start"
  )
)


extra_final <- anti_join(
  final_keys,
  expected_keys,
  by = c(
    "id_phase",
    "window_start"
  )
)


count_check <- expected_keys %>%

  count(
    id_phase,
    name = "expected"
  ) %>%

  left_join(

    final_keys %>%

      count(
        id_phase,
        name = "recovered"
      ),

    by = "id_phase"
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    recovered =
      coalesce(
        recovered,
        0L
      ),

    difference =
      recovered -
      expected
  )


cat(
  "\n",
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n",
  "FINAL F99 AKDE VALIDATION\n",
  paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


print(
  count_check,
  n = Inf
)


cat(
  "\nTotal expected:",
  nrow(expected_keys),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Total recovered:",
  nrow(final_keys),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Missing windows:",
  nrow(missing_final),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Unexpected windows:",
  nrow(extra_final),
  "\n"
)


# =============================================================================
# 17. FINAL SUCCESS MESSAGE
# =============================================================================

if (
  nrow(final_keys) == 1262 &&
  nrow(missing_final) == 0 &&
  nrow(extra_final) == 0
) {

  cat(
    "\n",
    paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
    "\n",
    "SUCCESS: FINAL F99 AKDE RECOVERY COMPLETE\n",
    paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""),
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )


  cat(
    "\nF99 Phase 1 should contain 306 rows.\n"
  )


  cat(
    "F99 Phase 2 should contain 956 rows.\n"
  )


  cat(
    "\nAll F99 AKDE values are standardized to km².\n"
  )

} else {

  cat(
    "\nF99 is not completely recovered yet.",
    " Rerun this same script to resume from checkpoints.\n"
  )
}

```


### Update the final CSV that will go into the autoencoder
### Final recovery and combination
```{r}
# =============================================================================
# FINAL MIGRATORY AKDE ASSEMBLY
#
# Combines:
#
#   75 repaired groups
#   10 recovered corrupted-RDS groups
#    2 recovered F99 groups
#
# Expected final total:
#
#   87 migratory ID-phase groups
#
# This script:
#
#   - reads everything fresh from disk
#   - checks exact window_start coverage against the original AKDE table
#   - checks units
#   - checks CI ordering
#   - checks duplicates
#   - checks missing/non-finite/non-positive values
#   - saves the final corrected migratory AKDE file ONLY if everything passes
# =============================================================================


# =============================================================================
# 1. PACKAGES
# =============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
library(tibble)


# =============================================================================
# 2. PATHS
# =============================================================================

MIGRATORY_BASE <- "<LOCAL_PATH>"


# 75 groups repaired from readable RDS files
GOOD_GROUPS_FILE <- file.path(
  MIGRATORY_BASE,
  "migratory_AKDE_7day_windows_CORRECTED_km2_GOOD_GROUPS.csv"
)


# 10 groups whose RDS files were corrupted and were recalculated
CORRUPT_RECOVERY_DIR <- file.path(
  MIGRATORY_BASE,
  "recovered_corrupt_groups_km2"
)


# F99 Phase 1 + Phase 2
F99_RECOVERY_DIR <- file.path(
  MIGRATORY_BASE,
  "recovered_F99_groups_km2"
)


# Original mixed-unit AKDE table
# Used ONLY to establish the expected window keys.
ORIGINAL_WINDOWS_FILE <- file.path(

# Final corrected output
FINAL_OUT <- file.path(

# =============================================================================

required_files <- c(

# =============================================================================
# 4. DATETIME HELPER
# =============================================================================

parse_window_time <- function(x) {

  parse_date_time(
    x,
    orders = c(
      "Y-m-d H:M:S",
      "Y-m-d H:M",
      "Y-m-d",
      "ymd HMS",
      "ymd HM",
      "ymd"
    ),
    tz = "UTC"
  )
}

# =============================================================================

bad_numeric <- final %>%

# =============================================================================
# 15. GROUP-BY-GROUP WINDOW COUNT CHECK

count_check <- expected_keys %>%

  count(

  left_join(

    final_keys %>%

      count(

      ),

    by = "id_phase"
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    corrected_windows =
      coalesce(
        corrected_windows,

    difference =

count_mismatches <- count_check %>%
```

### Final replacement and refinement
```{r}
# =============================================================================
# CORRECTED AKDE PATCH
#
# IMPORTANT FIXES:
#
#   1. Use dataset == "Resident" / "Migratory"
#      exactly as the original pipeline did.
#
#   2. Preserve existing id_phase.
#      Do NOT rebuild it if it is already present.
#
#   3. Join:
#
#        Resident:
#           id + date_time
#
#        Migratory:
#           id_phase + date_time
#
#   4. Only replace:
#
#        akde_low
#        akde_est
#        akde_high
#
# =============================================================================


library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)


# =============================================================================
# PATHS
# =============================================================================

AE_BASE <- "<LOCAL_PATH>"

TRAIN_FILE <- file.path(
  AE_BASE,
  "CWD_negative_training_with_seasons2.csv"
)

TEST_FILE <- file.path(
  AE_BASE,
  "CWD_positive_testing_with_seasons2.csv"
)

TRAIN_OUT <- file.path(
  AE_BASE,
  "CWD_negative_training_with_seasons2_AKDE_FIXED.csv"
)

TEST_OUT <- file.path(
  AE_BASE,
  "CWD_positive_testing_with_seasons2_AKDE_FIXED.csv"
)


# =============================================================================
# CHECK CORRECTED AKDE OBJECTS
# =============================================================================

if (!exists("resident_corrected")) {
  stop("resident_corrected is missing.")
}

if (!exists("final")) {
  stop("final migratory corrected AKDE object is missing.")
}


# =============================================================================
# SAFE TIME PARSER
# =============================================================================

parse_time_safe <- function(x) {

  if (inherits(x, "POSIXt")) {
    return(
      as.POSIXct(
        x,
        tz = "UTC"
      )
    )
  }

  x <- trimws(
    as.character(x)
  )

  out <- as.POSIXct(
    x,
    format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%OS",
    tz = "UTC"
  )

  bad <- is.na(out) & !is.na(x) & nzchar(x)

  if (any(bad)) {

    out2 <- as.POSIXct(
      x[bad],
      format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%OS",
      tz = "UTC"
    )

    out[bad] <- out2
  }

  bad <- is.na(out) & !is.na(x) & nzchar(x)

  if (any(bad)) {

    cat("\nUnparsed timestamp<LOCAL_PATH>")

    print(
      head(
        unique(x[bad]),
        20
      )
    )

    stop(
      paste(
        sum(bad),
        "timestamps failed parsing."
      )
    )
  }

  out
}


# =============================================================================
# BUILD RESIDENT LOOKUP
# =============================================================================

resident_lookup <- resident_corrected %>%

  transmute(

    id = as.character(id),

    join_time =
      parse_time_safe(
        window_start
      ),

    new_akde_low =
      low,

    new_akde_est =
      est,

    new_akde_high =
      high
  )


resident_dup <- resident_lookup %>%
```
