```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 6. BASE-R DATETIME PARSER
#
# Avoids the parse_date_time issue encountered previously.
# =============================================================================

parse_datetime_base <- function(x) {

  if (inherits(x, "POSIXt")) {

    return(
      as.POSIXct(
        x,
        tz = "UTC"
      )
    )
  }


  x_chr <- trimws(
    as.character(x)
  )


  x_chr <- sub(
    "Z$",
    "",
    x_chr
  )


  result <- as.POSIXct(
    x_chr,
    format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%OS",
    tz = "UTC"
  )


  missing <- (
    is.na(result) &
    !is.na(x_chr)
  )


  if (any(missing)) {

    result2 <- as.POSIXct(
      x_chr[missing],
      format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%OS",
      tz = "UTC"
    )


    result[
      missing
    ] <- result2
  }


  result
}

# =============================================================================
# 11. HELPER FUNCTIONS
#
# Reproduces original movement-metric calculations.
# =============================================================================

safe_mean <- function(x) {

  x <- x[
    is.finite(x)
  ]


  if (length(x) == 0) {

    return(
      NA_real_
    )
  }


  mean(x)
}


safe_var <- function(x) {

  x <- x[
    is.finite(x)
  ]


  if (length(x) < 2) {

    return(
      NA_real_
    )
  }


  var(x)
}


safe_sd <- function(x) {

  x <- x[
    is.finite(x)
  ]


  if (length(x) < 2) {

    return(
      NA_real_
    )
  }


  sd(x)
}


safe_skewness <- function(x) {

  x <- x[
    is.finite(x)
  ]


  if (
    length(x) < 3 ||
    sd(x) == 0
  ) {

    return(
      NA_real_
    )
  }


  e1071::skewness(
    x,
    na.rm = TRUE,
    type = 2
  )
}


safe_kurtosis <- function(x) {

  x <- x[
    is.finite(x)
  ]


  if (
    length(x) < 4 ||
    sd(x) == 0
  ) {

    return(
      NA_real_
    )
  }


  e1071::kurtosis(
    x,
    na.rm = TRUE,
    type = 2
  )
}


wrap_angle <- function(x) {

  atan2(
    sin(x),
    cos(x)
  )
}


rolling_sinuosity_function <- function(
  x,
  y
) {

  valid <- (
    is.finite(x) &
    is.finite(y)
  )


  x <- x[
    valid
  ]

  y <- y[
    valid
  ]


  if (length(x) < 2) {

    return(
      NA_real_
    )
  }


  net_displacement <- sqrt(

    (
      x[
        length(x)
      ] -
      x[1]
    )^2 +

    (
      y[
        length(y)
      ] -
      y[1]
    )^2
  )


  path_length <- sum(

    sqrt(
      diff(x)^2 +
      diff(y)^2
    ),

    na.rm = TRUE
  )


  if (
    !is.finite(path_length) ||
    path_length <= 0
  ) {

    return(
      NA_real_
    )
  }


  net_displacement /
    path_length
}

# =============================================================================
# 13. INDEPENDENTLY RECALCULATE BASIC MOVEMENT METRICS
# =============================================================================

audit_data <- all_data %>%

  arrange(
    id,
    season,
    date_time
  ) %>%

  group_by(
    id,
    season
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Coordinate changes
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    dx =
      coord_x_audit -
      lag(
        coord_x_audit
      ),


    dy =
      coord_y_audit -
      lag(
        coord_y_audit
      ),


    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Time interval in seconds
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    dt =
      as.numeric(

        difftime(

          date_time,

          lag(
            date_time
          ),

          units = "secs"
        )
      ),


    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Step distance
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    dist =
      sqrt(
        dx^2 +
        dy^2
      ),


    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Invalid time intervals
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    dt =
      if_else(

        is.na(dt) |
        dt <= 0,

        NA_real_,

        dt
      ),


    dist =
      if_else(

        is.na(dt),

        NA_real_,

        dist
      ),


    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Velocity
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    velo =
      dist /
      dt,


    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Absolute bearing angle
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    abs_angle =
      atan2(
        dy,
        dx
      ),


    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Relative angle
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    rel_angle =
      wrap_angle(

        abs_angle -
        lag(
          abs_angle
        )
      ),


    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Absolute relative angle
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    abs_rel_angle =
      abs(
        rel_angle
      ),


    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # R2n
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    r2n =
      (
        coord_x_audit -
        first(
          coord_x_audit
        )
      )^2 +

      (
        coord_y_audit -
        first(
          coord_y_audit
        )
      )^2,


    R2n =
      r2n
  ) %>%

  ungroup()


# =============================================================================
# 14. INDEPENDENTLY RECALCULATE 56-FIX SINUOSITY
# =============================================================================

audit_data <- audit_data %>%

  arrange(
    id,
    season,
    date_time

      slide2_dbl(

        .f =
          rolling_sinuosity_function,

        .before =
          55,

        .after =
          0,

        .complete =
          FALSE
      )
  ) %>%

  ungroup()

      ),

      slide_dbl(

        .before = 55,
        .complete = FALSE
      ),


    # =========================================================================
    # VELOCITY
    # =========================================================================

    rolling_velo_mean =
      slide_dbl(
        velo,
        safe_mean,
        .before = 55,
        .complete = FALSE
      ),


    rolling_velo_var =
      slide_dbl(
        velo,
        safe_var,
        .before = 55,
        .complete = FALSE
      ),


    rolling_velo_sd =
      slide_dbl(
        velo,
        safe_sd,
        .before = 55,
        .complete = FALSE
      ),


    rolling_velo_skew =
      slide_dbl(
        velo,
        safe_skewness,
        .before = 55,
        .complete = FALSE
      ),


    rolling_velo_kurt =
      slide_dbl(
        velo,
        safe_kurtosis,
        .before = 55,
        .complete = FALSE
      ),


    # =========================================================================
    # R2N
    # =========================================================================

    rolling_r2n_mean =
      slide_dbl(
        r2n,
        safe_mean,
        .before = 55,
        .complete = FALSE
      ),


    rolling_r2n_var =
      slide_dbl(
        r2n,
        safe_var,
        .before = 55,
        .complete = FALSE
      ),


    rolling_r2n_sd =
      slide_dbl(
        r2n,
        safe_sd,
        .before = 55,
        .complete = FALSE
      ),


    rolling_r2n_skew =
      slide_dbl(
        r2n,
        safe_skewness,
        .before = 55,
        .complete = FALSE
      ),


    rolling_r2n_kurt =
      slide_dbl(
        r2n,
        safe_kurtosis,
        .before = 55,
        .complete = FALSE
      ),


    # =========================================================================
    # SINUOSITY
    # =========================================================================

    rolling_sinuosity_mean =
      slide_dbl(
        sinuosity,
        safe_mean,
        .before = 55,
        .complete = FALSE
      ),


    rolling_sinuosity_var =
      slide_dbl(
        sinuosity,
        safe_var,
        .before = 55,
        .complete = FALSE
      ),


    rolling_sinuosity_sd =
      slide_dbl(
        sinuosity,

        .before = 55,

      ),

      ),


    rolling_sinuosity_kurt =

# =============================================================================
# 16. COMPARISON FUNCTION
# =============================================================================

compare_metric <- function(
  data,
  metric,
  tolerance = 1e-10
) {

  stored_name <- paste0(
    metric,
    "_stored"
  )


  stored <- data[[stored_name]]


  recalculated <- data[[metric]]


  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # NA structure
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  na_mismatch <- xor(
    is.na(stored),
    is.na(recalculated)
  )


  both_present <- (
    !is.na(stored) &
    !is.na(recalculated)
  )


  equal <- rep(
    FALSE,
    length(stored)
  )


  # Both NA = equal

  equal[
    is.na(stored) &
    is.na(recalculated)
  ] <- TRUE


  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Finite numeric values
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  finite_pair <- (
    both_present &
    is.finite(stored) &
    is.finite(recalculated)
  )


  difference <- rep(
    NA_real_,
    length(stored)
  )


  difference[
    finite_pair
  ] <- abs(

    stored[
      finite_pair
    ] -

    recalculated[
      finite_pair
    ]
  )


  equal[
    finite_pair
  ] <- (

    difference[
      finite_pair
    ]

    <=

    (
      tolerance +

      tolerance *

      pmax(

        abs(
          stored[
            finite_pair
          ]
        ),

        abs(
          recalculated[
            finite_pair
          ]
        )
      )
    )
  )


  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Non-finite pair such as Inf
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  nonfinite_pair <- (
    both_present &
    !finite_pair
  )


  if (any(nonfinite_pair)) {

    equal[
      nonfinite_pair
    ] <- (

      stored[
        nonfinite_pair
      ]

      ==

      recalculated[
        nonfinite_pair
      ]
    )
  }


  mismatch <- !equal


  finite_differences <- difference[
    is.finite(
      difference
    )
  ]


  max_abs_difference <- if (
    length(finite_differences) > 0
  ) {

    max(
      finite_differences,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

  } else {

    NA_real_
  }


  tibble(

    metric =
      metric,

    n_rows =
      length(stored),

    stored_nonmissing =
      sum(
        !is.na(stored)
      ),

    recalculated_nonmissing =
      sum(
        !is.na(recalculated)
      ),

    na_structure_mismatches =
      sum(
        na_mismatch
      ),

    total_mismatches =
      sum(
        mismatch
      ),

    max_abs_difference =
      max_abs_difference
  )
}


# =============================================================================
# 17. AUDIT ALL MANUALLY CREATED MOVEMENT METRICS
# =============================================================================

metric_audit <- map_dfr(

  movement_metrics,

  function(metric) {

    compare_metric(
      data = audit_data,
      metric = metric
    )
  }
)


cat(
  "\n",
  paste(rep("=", 120), collapse = ""),
  "\nINDEPENDENT MOVEMENT METRIC AUDIT\n",
  paste(rep("=", 120), collapse = ""),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


print(
  metric_audit,
  n = Inf,
  width = Inf
)


metrics_with_mismatches <- metric_audit %>%

  filter(
    total_mismatches > 0
  )


total_metric_mismatches <- sum(
  metric_audit$total_mismatches
)


cat(
  "\nMetrics checked:",
  nrow(metric_audit),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Metrics with mismatches:",
  nrow(metrics_with_mismatches),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Total row-level mismatches:",
  total_metric_mismatches,
  "\n"
)


if (nrow(metrics_with_mismatches) > 0) {

  cat(
    "\nMETRICS WITH MISMATCHE<LOCAL_PATH>"
  )


  print(
    metrics_with_mismatches,
    n = Inf,
    width = Inf
  )


  stop(
    paste0(
      "Movement-metric audit failed. ",
      "FINAL files were NOT overwritten."
    )
  )
}


cat(
  "\nPASS: ALL MANUALLY CREATED MOVEMENT METRICS REPRODUCED.\n"
)


# =============================================================================
# 18. SAVE MOVEMENT METRIC AUDIT
# =============================================================================

write_csv(
  metric_audit,
  AUDIT_OUT
)


# =============================================================================
# 19. IDENTIFY >150 KM^2 AKDE ROWS IN ORIGINAL DATA
# =============================================================================

train_remove <- (
  !is.na(
    train_original$akde_est
  ) &
  train_original$akde_est >
    AKDE_MAX_KM2
)


test_remove <- (
  !is.na(
    test_original$akde_est
  ) &
  test_original$akde_est >
    AKDE_MAX_KM2
)


train_removed_n <- sum(
  train_remove
)


test_removed_n <- sum(
  test_remove
)


total_removed_n <- (
  train_removed_n +
  test_removed_n
)


cat(
  "\n",
  paste(rep("=", 120), collapse = ""),
  "\nAKDE 150 KM^2 QC CHECK\n",
  paste(rep("=", 120), collapse = ""),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


cat(
  "\nTraining rows removed:",
  train_removed_n,
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Testing rows removed:",
  test_removed_n,
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "TOTAL rows removed:",
  total_removed_n,
  "\n"
)


if (
  total_removed_n !=
    EXPECTED_TOTAL_REMOVED
) {

  stop(
    paste0(
      "Expected ",
      EXPECTED_TOTAL_REMOVED,
      " total rows above 150 km^2, but found ",
      total_removed_n,
      ". FINAL files were NOT overwritten."
    )
  )
}


cat(
  "\nPASS: Exactly 259 rows meet the >150 km^2 AKDE QC rule.\n"
)


# =============================================================================
# 20. CREATE FINAL TRIMMED DATASETS
#
# IMPORTANT:
#
# We filter the ORIGINAL stored datasets.
#
# We do NOT use audit_data here.
#
# Therefore none of the recalculated audit columns or recalculated movement
# metrics can accidentally enter the final model datasets.
#
# No movement metric is recalculated after trimming.
# =============================================================================

train_final_data <- train_original %>%

  filter(
    is.na(akde_est) |
    akde_est <= AKDE_MAX_KM2
  )


test_final_data <- test_original %>%

  filter(
    is.na(akde_est) |
    akde_est <= AKDE_MAX_KM2
  )


# =============================================================================
# 21. VERIFY ROW COUNTS
# =============================================================================

if (
  nrow(train_original) -
    nrow(train_final_data)
  !=
    train_removed_n
) {

  stop(
    "Training row-count validation failed."
  )
}


if (
  nrow(test_original) -
    nrow(test_final_data)
  !=
    test_removed_n
) {

  stop(
    "Testing row-count validation failed."
  )
}


if (
  (
    nrow(train_original) +
    nrow(test_original)
  ) -
  (
    nrow(train_final_data) +
    nrow(test_final_data)
  )
  != EXPECTED_TOTAL_REMOVED
) {

  stop(
    "Combined row-count validation failed."
  )
}


# =============================================================================
# 22. VERIFY NO AKDE_EST >150 REMAINS
# =============================================================================

if (
  any(
    train_final_data$akde_est >
      AKDE_MAX_KM2,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
) {

  stop(
    "Training data still contain akde_est >150."
  )
}


if (
  any(
    test_final_data$akde_est >
      AKDE_MAX_KM2,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
) {

  stop(
    "Testing data still contain akde_est >150."
  )
}


cat(
  "\nPASS: No AKDE point estimates >150 km^2 remain.\n"
)


# =============================================================================
# 23. VERIFY NO COLUMNS CHANGED
# =============================================================================

if (
  !identical(
    names(train_original),
    names(train_final_data)
  )
) {

  stop(
    "Training column structure changed."
  )
}


if (
  !identical(
    names(test_original),
    names(test_final_data)
  )
) {

  stop(
    "Testing column structure changed."
  )
}


cat(
  "PASS: Column structures are unchanged.\n"
)


# =============================================================================
# 24. VERIFY NO DEER WERE LOST ENTIRELY
# =============================================================================

train_ids_before <- sort(
  unique(
    as.character(
      train_original$id
    )
  )
)


train_ids_after <- sort(
  unique(
    as.character(
      train_final_data$id
    )
  )
)


test_ids_before <- sort(
  unique(
    as.character(
      test_original$id
    )
  )
)


test_ids_after <- sort(
  unique(
    as.character(
      test_final_data$id
    )
  )
)


if (
  !identical(
    train_ids_before,
    train_ids_after
  )
) {

  stop(
    "At least one training deer was removed entirely."
  )
}


if (
  !identical(
    test_ids_before,
    test_ids_after
  )
) {

  stop(
    "At least one testing deer was removed entirely."
  )
}


cat(
  "PASS: No deer were removed entirely.\n"
)


# =============================================================================
# 25. FINAL DATASET SUMMARY
# =============================================================================

final_summary <- tibble(

  dataset = c(
    "CWD-negative training",
    "CWD-positive testing",
    "TOTAL"
  ),

  original_rows = c(
    nrow(train_original),
    nrow(test_original),
    nrow(train_original) +
      nrow(test_original)
  ),

  removed_over_150 = c(
    train_removed_n,
    test_removed_n,
    total_removed_n
  ),

  final_rows = c(
    nrow(train_final_data),
    nrow(test_final_data),
    nrow(train_final_data) +
      nrow(test_final_data)
  )
) %>%

  mutate(

    percent_removed =
      100 *
      removed_over_150 /
      original_rows,

    percent_retained =
      100 *
      final_rows /
      original_rows
  )


cat(
  "\n",
  paste(rep("=", 120), collapse = ""),
  "\nFINAL DATASET SUMMARY\n",
  paste(rep("=", 120), collapse = ""),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


print(
  final_summary,
  n = Inf,
  width = Inf
)


# =============================================================================
# 26. OVERWRITE FINAL MODEL FILES
#
# write_csv() overwrites existing files with the same path.
# =============================================================================

write_csv(
  train_final_data,
  TRAIN_FINAL,
  na = ""
)


write_csv(
  test_final_data,
  TEST_FINAL,
  na = ""
)


# =============================================================================
# 27. VERIFY OUTPUT FILES EXIST
# =============================================================================

if (!file.exists(TRAIN_FINAL)) {

  stop(
    "Final training file was not written."
  )
}


if (!file.exists(TEST_FINAL)) {

  stop(
    "Final testing file was not written."
  )
}


# =============================================================================
# 28. READ SAVED FILES BACK IN
# =============================================================================

train_saved <- read_csv(
  TRAIN_FINAL,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)


test_saved <- read_csv(
  TEST_FINAL,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)


if (
  nrow(train_saved) !=
    nrow(train_final_data)
) {

  stop(
    "Saved training row count does not match."
  )
}


if (
  nrow(test_saved) !=
    nrow(test_final_data)
) {

  stop(
    "Saved testing row count does not match."
  )
}


if (
  any(
    train_saved$akde_est >
      AKDE_MAX_KM2,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
) {

  stop(
    "Saved training file contains AKDE >150."
  )
}


if (
  any(
    test_saved$akde_est >
      AKDE_MAX_KM2,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
) {

  stop(
    "Saved testing file contains AKDE >150."
  )
}


# =============================================================================
# 29. FINAL SUCCESS REPORT
# =============================================================================

cat(
  "\n",
  paste(rep("=", 120), collapse = ""),
  "\nFINAL QC RESULT\n",
  paste(rep("=", 120), collapse = ""),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


cat(
  "\nMovement metrics independently checked:",
  nrow(metric_audit),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Movement metrics with mismatches:",
  nrow(metrics_with_mismatches),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Total movement-metric row mismatches:",
  total_metric_mismatches,
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "\nAKDE rows removed:",
  total_removed_n,
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Expected AKDE rows removed:",
  EXPECTED_TOTAL_REMOVED,
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "\nFinal combined rows:",
  nrow(train_final_data) +
    nrow(test_final_data),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "\n",
  paste(rep("=", 120), collapse = ""),
  "\nSUCCESS: FINAL DATASETS VALIDATED AND OVERWRITTEN\n",
  paste(rep("=", 120), collapse = ""),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


cat(
  "\nAll manually created movement metrics reproduced successfully.\n"
)


cat(
  "Exactly 259 AKDE >150 km^2 observations were removed.\n"
)


cat(
  "Movement metrics were NOT recalculated after trimming.\n"
)


cat(
  "No deer were removed entirely.\n"
)


cat(
  "\nFINAL TRAINING FIL<LOCAL_PATH>",
  TRAIN_FINAL,
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


cat(
  "\nFINAL TESTING FIL<LOCAL_PATH>",
  TEST_FINAL,
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


cat(
  "\nMOVEMENT METRIC AUDI<LOCAL_PATH>",
  AUDIT_OUT,
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)
```
